title: Cassandra — Chapter 1: The Banner
subtitle: Pay bahut zyada thi. Wo bhi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Gyarah din ki chalai. Do tambe ke sikke bache, dono itne ghise hue ke unpe jhagda ho sake.
Tune docks try kiye, mills, stables, temple ki rasoi. Har jagah wahi kandhe uthna aur wahi jumla: *kaam nahi, is season nahi, agle shehar try kar.*
Tere boots ko agle shehar pe opinion thi. Tere pet ko har cheez pe.
To tu shehar se north road pe chal raha tha, plan sirf *chalte raho*, jab hawa ne ek kapda jo khambhe pe tana tha, ghumaya aur tujhe muh dikhaya.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Mehnga kapda. Itna mehnga ke khambhe pe tane hone ka nahi. Kisne letters soch-samajh ke likhe the, jaise log likhte hain jab unhe maan'na chahiye.
**SERVANT CHAHIYE — HOUSEHOLD OF HER HIGHNESS THE PRINCESS CASSANDRA.**
**BEES SILVER HAFTAY KA. KAMRA. KHANA. LIVERY MILEGI.**
Bees silver haftay ka. Tune teen baar padha. Zindagi mein bees silver sirf ek baar haath mein aaye the, aur wo kisi aur ke the.
Neeche chhoti writing thi. Baad mein us chhoti writing pe tu bahut sochne wala tha.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: *Applicants west gate pe hazir hon. Jo Highness ka time barbaad kare, unhe grounds se nikaal diya jayega.*
Tu west gate pe pahunch gaya, faisla khatam hone se pehle.
Nau aur mard pehle se aangan mein khade — tujhse bade, tujhse saaf, ek wo coat pehne jo das saal pehle fashion tha aur ye jaanta tha.
Tu do ghante thand mein khada raha. Ek ek karke wo chhote andhere darwaze se andar gaye. Ek ek karke bahar aaye, aur koi bhi rastay mein kisi ko nahi dekha.
Tere se pehle aakhri wala *daudte* nikla. Kaan laal. Shirt theek karta haathon se jo theek kaam nahi kar rahe the.
Phir darwaza phir khula, aur andar se awaaz aayi: *Next.*

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Andar ka kamra garam tha, chhat neechi, beeswax aur starch ki smell.
Ek aurat writing table ke peeche khadi thi, ledger khula. Kaali dress gale tak button, safed apron bina ek silwat, gehri baal itne kas ke bandhe ke lagta tha baalon ki saza.
Wo apni posture se chhoti thi. Sundar is tarah ke tez kiya gaya ho, naram nahi — aisi aurat jo *seedha khada ho* ko dhamki aur tarif dono bana de.
Usne salaam nahi kiya. Tere boots dekhe. Phir haath. Phir, aakhir, chehra, aur muh ke kone mein kuch halka hila, jaise tera chehra sabse kam nirash karne wala hissa tha.
*Darwaza band kar,* usne kaha. *Garmi nikal rahi hai.*

nodes.speaker: Beatrix
lines: Main Beatrix hoon. Highness ke ghar ki head. Is palace mein jiske haath hain aur naam hai, wo mujhe jawab deta hai. 🕯️
Nau mard aaj wahi khade ho chuke jahan tu khada hai. Pata chalna hai unka kya hua?
Do banner nahi padh sake. Teen meri nazar nahi sambhaal sake. Ek ne poocha Princess kaisi dikhti hai — usko maliyon se nikalwaya.
Aur aakhri, jise tu daudte dekh, almost end tak pahuncha. Phir bola wo *uska khayal achhe se rakhega.* 😏
Bees silver haftay ka, aur har ek socha ye kaam cheezein uthane ka hai. Muh band kar aur haath table pe rakh jahan main dekh sakun.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tune haath table pe rakh diye. Wo dheere table ke round aayi, aur kamra chhota ho gaya.
Usne tera right haath dono haathon se pakda — na narm, na sakht, bas *poora* — aur palta. Thumb telay pe, calluses pe, phati knuckle pe, purani rassi ki jalan pe.
"Kaam wale haath," usne dheere kaha, ledger ko zyada, tujhe kam. "Achha. Uske haath kharab nahi hone chahiye, aur kisi ko kharab karna padega."
Wo tere peeche ghumi. Ek haath kandhon ke beech dabaya — *seedha khada ho* — aur instruction se ek beat zyada raha.
Phir wo phir saamne thi, itni kareeb ke tu apron ke starch ki smell le sake, aur do ungliyon se tere shirt ka upar wala button khola, pooche bagair, chehra dekhti rahi ke wo kya karega.
Kuch kiya. Ye bhi usne note kiya.

nodes.speaker: Beatrix
lines: Hila mat. Main tujhe kuch nahi kar rahi. Main inventory le rahi hoon. 🖤

Highness tujhe kapdon mein dekhegi, bina kapdon, subah, aadhi raat, apne bath chamber mein aur court mein kursi ke peeche. Wo tujhe wo cheezein degi jo abhi pehni thi. Wo tujhse baat karegi jab tu ghutnon pe hoga.
Isliye mujhe exactly pata hona chahiye kitna tu pehli baar tootega jab wo ye karegi.
Teri pulse se — aur main *pulse* se judge kar rahi hoon, mera haath tere collar pe hai — kaafi zyada. 😏
Ye inkaar nahi. Is palace ke aadhe mard uske aas-paas bekaar ho jaate. Farak ye hai unhone seekh liya bekaar *chupchaap* rehna.
Ab. Teen sawaal, aur mujhe chhote jawaab chahiye. Jhoot bola to main jaan lungi jumla khatam hone se pehle.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Wo ledger ke paas hatti, pen duboya, aur baithi nahi.
"Ek. Tu broke hai. Kitna broke?" — tune bataya, usne bina comment likh diya.
"Do. Agar tu is ghar mein gayab ho jaye to kaun dhoondhega?" — koi nahi, tune kaha. Wo bhi likha, aur uske chehre pe kuch aaya jo tu padh nahi saka.
"Teen." Pen ruka. Usne nazar uthayi.
"Bees silver haftay ka, char guna rate. Do ghante thande aangan mein sochne ko mile. Bata, tujhe lagta hai tujhe kis cheez ke paise mil rahe."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Mombatti phatki. Sar ke upar kahin floorboard chiki, phir chup — jaise jo upar tha, sunne ke liye ruk gaya.
Beatrix wait karti rahi, pen hawa mein.
Tu kya jawab dega?

choices.label: Itaat. Aap meri peeth nahi kharid rahe, meri chup aur mere ghutne kharid rahe ho.
Char guna rate matlab char guna musibat. Raat ko pata chalne se pehle aapse sunna better hai. 😏
(Tu kuch nahi kehta. Uski nazar pakadta hai aur chup usi se bharwata hai.)
choices.me: Tu uski nazar pakadta hai aur kuch nahi kehta, chup baithe rehti hai jab tak usko pehle hona pade.

nodes.speaker: Beatrix
lines: …Itaat. 🖤
Wah. Nau mard aur kisi ne ye word nahi kaha. Sab ne kaha *loyalty*, ya *mehnat*, ya — Khuda bachaaye — *discretion.*
To tu samajh chuka. Is ghar mein tu haathon ka joda nahi. Tu cheez hai jo aati hai jab wo kehti aa, rukti hai jab wo kehti ruk.
Ye tujhe jitna lag raha usse zyada darana chahiye. Mujhe interesting lagta hai. Dekhungi ye himmat hai ya himmat ke coat mein koi bahut zyada bewakoof cheez.
Baith. Tune abhi is baat ko kaafi lamba kar diya. 🕯️

nodes.speaker: Beatrix
lines: Musibat. 😏 Wo mere muh pe kehta hai, mere kamre mein, shirt khuli.
Seedha chahiye? Theek, Thursday tak to pata chal hi jayega.

Highness unnees ki hai, tez, dimaag se bore, aur chaar sau log dekh rahe hain jo sab usse kuch maangte hain. Wo zalim nahi. Wo *precise* hai, jo zyada bura hai, kyunki zalim thak jaati hai aur precision kabhi nahi.
Wo teri edge dhoondhegi aur dabayegi jab tak exactly pata na chal jaye kahan hai. Yahi musibat hai. Yahi char guna.
Aur tu khada hai almost khush. Baith ja, warna main teri judgement pe kuch bura likh dungi. 🕯️

nodes.speaker: Beatrix
lines: Hm. 🖤
Tu mujhe pehle bolne pe majboor karega. Mere kamre mein. Pehle ghante mein.

Pata hai ye kitna rare hai? Mard bolte hain jab darte hain. Hawa promises se bhar dete hain taake main na sunun unki jeb kitni khali hai. Tu bas khada raha aur uncomfortable hone diya — phir *mere liye* uncomfortable hone diya.
Ye aaj teri sabse achhi ya sabse buri cheez hai, aur main sach mein abhi nahi bata sakti kaunsi.
Baith. Ja. Aur wo chehra hata, koi upar dekh le usse pehle. 🕯️

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Usne lambay time likha. Jawaab se zyada.
Tu sakht stool pe baitha, shirt khuli, pen hilta dekha, aur samajh gaya jo kuch wo us ledger mein daal rahi hai, wo is imarat ke har darwaze se tere saath jayega.
Phir usne page sukhaya, kitaab band ki, peeche shelf se ek folded bundle nikala: kaala oon, silver buttons, itna press ke zinda lagta. Livery. Tera size, lagbhag.
Usne tere haathon mein rakha aur ungliyan upar rakhi ek pal, taake tujhe uski taraf dekhna pade.
"Tu hired hai," usne kaha. "Khuda tera bhala kare."

nodes.speaker: Beatrix
lines: Dhyan de. Ye woh rules hain jo main do baar dungi, aur main ek baar de rahi hoon. 🖤
Tu usko *Highness* bol. Kabhi naam nahi. Ek baar nahi, kabhi nahi, apne dimaag ke andar bhi nahi — main promise karti hoon ye nikal jaata hai, aur yahan nikle to behtar, upar nahi.
Uske saamne tab tak mat bol jab tak wo na bole. Bina hukm usko mat chhoo. Kaam se zyada der mat dekh.
Aur jab wo aisa order de jisse tu chup ho jaye aur kaan ke peeche garam — kyunki degi, servant, zaroor degi — tu kehta hai *haan, Highness*, karta hai, aur nahi dikhata iski keemat kya thi.
Uske paas apna ledger hai. Pata tha? Chhoti kitaab, uske haath mein, har servant ki naakaami. Meri unnees pages hai aur main kabhi late nahi hui. 😏
Dho. Kapde pehn. Third bell. Seerhiyon pe interesting mat ban.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tu patthar ke corridor mein badla, mombatti saath. Livery aise fit hui jaise tera wait kar rahi ho, jo aaj ki sabse ajeeb baat thi.
Kaala oon. Silver buttons. Bees silver haftay ka aur bistar jo tu ne abhi nahi dekha.
Aakhri button lagate waqt suna — upar, servants ki seerhi ke top landing pe. Skirts. Bina jaldi kadam. Koi jo der se sun raha tha aur aakhir mein sunaai dena chahta tha.
Tune wo kiya jo koi mard kare. Upar dekha.
Bannister pe haath. Rings. Hara silk ka tukda. Aur kuch nahi — seerhi ke mod ne baaki le liya.
Phir awaaz, dheemi aur bilkul shaant, itni tez ke sirf tujhe mile, kisi aur ko nahi.
To ye daswan hai. 👑
Beatrix kehti hai tu samajhta hai tujhe kis liye rakha gaya. Wo aksar sahi hoti hai, aur wo kabhi generous nahi, to interview kaafi kuch hua hoga.
Upar mat aa. Jawaab bhi mat de — tujhe bolne ki ijazat nahi mili aur main dekhna chahti hoon tu kitni der sambhalta hai.
Good boy. 🖤
Third bell, servant. Mera chamber. Pani garam lana, aankhein floor pe, aur saath mein pata karenge bees silver kya kharidta hai.
(To be continued — Chapter 2: The Table 🕯️)

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Third bell.
Tu paani do flights upar le gaya, handle pe kapda, dil khargosh ki tarah. Garam, usne kaha. Itna garam ke dard ho, jo sahi amount laga.
Beatrix landing pe mili, ek baar dekha, aur collar jhatke se theek kiya, lagbhag sar utar diya.
"Aankhein neeche. Jab bole tab bol. Aur jo wo kare," usne kaha, "uspe awaaz mat nikaal."
Phir usne tere liye darwaza khola aur andar nahi aayi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Uska chamber sabse garam kamra tha jisme tu khada hua. Aag oonchi, teen candelabra din mein jal rahe, floor pe fur, hari cheezon aur mehngi smoke ki smell.
Wo khidki ke paas neechi couch pe thi, ek taang khinchi, emerald silk mein jo pehna nahi, set kiya gaya tha — ek kandhe se girta, ghutne se aage khula, nanga paon cushion pe.
Tune aankhein floor pe rakhin jitni der sambhal saka. Phir fail hua, aur dekha.

Unnees. Dark chestnut baal raat ke pin se khule, patla silver circlet abhi bhi, kyunki utarne ki takleef nahi ki. Grey-green aankhein pehle se tujh pe — wo darwaza dekh rahi thi, wait kar rahi isi cheez pe pakadne ko.
Wo sabse khoobsurat cheez thi jo tune dekhi, aur tujhse dekhe jaane pe bilkul impressed nahi thi.
"Wahi hai," usne kaha. "Nau seconds. Beatrix kehti hai aakhri wala char sambhala. Pani rakh aur mat bol."
Idhar aa. Itna kareeb nahi — *wahan.* 👑
Ab. Haath aur ghutnon pe, khidki ki taraf. Peeth flat.
Tune sahi suna aur main do baar nahi kahungi. Neeche.
Zyada flat. Elbow seedhe, kandhe barabar, sar neeche. Agar chehra dikhe to galat kar raha hai.
Achha. Wahi pakad. 🖤

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Fur talwon ke neeche garam thi. Position ki yahi ek mehrbani thi.
Wo couch se utri aur tere round dheere chali, nange paon chup, silk phusphusata. Haath kandhon ke beech daba — *neeche* — phir do ungliyon se kamar uthaya jab tak spine ek line na ban jaye.
Tune anaaj ke bote uthaye hain, gaadi khinchi hai. Zindagi mein kabhi arrange nahi hua.
"Better," usne kaha, upar aur peeche se. "Tu pichhle se chawda hai. Kaam ka hai."
Phir couch chiki jab wo kinare baithi — aur nangi taang tere upar aayi, pindli flat peeth pe, ankle atka, tujhe footrest ki tarah use kiya bina ek word ke ke tu mard hai, furniture nahi.
Silk jaangh pe khula. Tu floor dekh raha tha aur phir bhi pata tha.
Beatrix ne tere baare mein ek page likha. Sunna hai wo kya sochti hai?
Jawaab mat de. Zaroor sunna hai. 😏
*Haath: kaam wale, tez dimaag se kharab nahi.* Ye uski tarif hai, jo bataati hai uski tarif ki keemat.
*Meri nazar sambhali. Mujhe pehle bolne pe majboor kiya.* Hm. Usne underline kiya. Beatrix ne nau saal mein teen cheezein underline ki hain.
*Khandaan nahi. Udhaar nahi. Agar wo bahar na aaye to koi nahi dhoondhega.* …Usne ye mere liye likha kyunki aisi cheez mujhe jaanna pasand hai.
Aur neeche, sabse saaf haath: *wo samajhta hai usko kis cheez ke paise mil rahe.* 🖤
To dekhte hain ye sach hai ya nahi? Kyunki Beatrix staff rakhti hai. Main decide karti hoon kaun *rehta hai.*

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Usne poora page do baar zor se padha, bilkul bina jaldi, jo line pasand aayi uspe teri pasli pe heel aalsi ghoomti rahi.
Tere haath pehle se bolne lage. Dard abhi nahi — dard ka wada.
Neeche palace mein koi darwaza bang hua, koi hasa, tujhse koi lena dena nahi. Teri poori duniya floor ke char points aur ek royal taang ke garam wazan tak simat gayi jo tujhe jagah pe pakde thi.
Usne page fold kiya, cushion pe giraaya, aur khincha — tune pindli se spine tak mehsoos kiya — phir wo jumla kaha jisne subah badal di.
"Mujhe bhookh lagi hai."
*Beatrix.* 🔔
Nashta. Sab — fruit, shahad, garam chocolate, achha cup, roz wala nahi.
Aur Beatrix? Tray mat lana.
Tune suna. Tray passage mein chhod. Mere paas table hai. 👑

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Darwaza khula. Skirts, chaabiyan, garam bread ki smell.
Phir rukawat — lambi — jab Beatrix ne dekha aadmi jise ek ghanta pehle rakha, haath-ghutnon pe, malika ki taang uski peeth pe.
Tu uska chehra nahi dekh saka. Tune suna usne tray passage mein rakh di jaise hukm tha, aur saans mein kuch jo na-pasand bhi ho sakta tha, pehchaan bhi.
"Jaisa aap chahein, Highness," usne kaha.
Aur phir, ek ek karke, usne nashta tere upar utarna shuru kiya.

Pehle folded linen napkin kandhon ke beech — itni mehrbani ki. Phir wazan: porcelain plate, thandi aur flat, gardan ke neeche. Chhoti dish shahad ki saath. Katé hue fruit ki bowl kamar pe. Do silver chamach spine ke gaddhe pe cross.
Aur aakhir, bilkul upar, kandhe ke paas muscle ki ridge pe — achha cup. Kinare se ungli bhar, bhaap nikalta.

nodes.speaker: Beatrix
lines: Plate ke neeche napkin, Highness, warna pasina aaye to porcelain sarak jayegi. …Pasina aayega. Sabko aata hai. 🕯️
(phir dheere, tere kaan ke paas, cup seedha karte)
Pet se saans le, seene se nahi. Seene ki saans cup jhukaati hai aur cup hi matter karta hai.
Upar mat dekh. Tab tak mat bol jab tak wo seedha sawaal na poochhe. Haath kaampen to elbow se, kandhe se nahi.
Aur ladke — jo bhi ho, chocolate mat giraana. South se hai. Tujhse mehnga hai. 🖤

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Beatrix hatti. Darwaza click. Aur Princess, bina jaldi, teri peeth se nashta khane lagi.

Plate khisaki. Chamach uthi, use hui, aadhe inch door wapas rakhi. Bowl ka wazan har baar badla jab usne fruit liya. Cup — cup wahan baitha linen se teri skin mein garmi daalta, aur har saans pe liquid ka chhota gola tu mehsoos karta.
Pasina kanpati se jaw tak latka. Kandhe shikayat se jalan tak pahunche. Right haath ke neeche fur sikud gayi aur tu theek karne ki himmat nahi ki.

"Tujhe terms pata hone chahiye," usne kaha, pear ke tukde ke saath, jaise mausam ki baat. "Agar kuch gire — kuch bhi, chamach, reza, chocolate ki ek boond mere floor pe — tu nikal. Saza nahi. *Nikal.* West gate se, plate saaf hone se pehle, khali haath, aur Beatrix tere naam ke saath *unsuitable* likhegi."
"Is saal meri char tables thin," usne joda. "Koi doosre cup tak nahi pahunchi."
Pakad. Hilna mat. 🖤
Pata hai main ye kyun karti hoon? Khane ke liye nahi. Khana us table pe better hota jo kaampe nahi.
Main isliye karti hoon kyunki mard mujhe kuch bhi bol dega. Beatrix ke chhote kamre mein bees silver pe itaat ki qasam, aur matlab tab tak jab tak uski keemat na lage.
Is ki keemat lag rahi hai. Tere haath chilla rahe — main heel se mehsoos karti hoon — aur tu abhi flat hai, ek awaaz nahi, aur *ye* information hai jo main aur kisi tarah nahi kharid sakti.
…Ab dekhte hain tu kitna sach mein maanta tha.
(cup uth'ta hai — aur do inch ooncha wapas, kaampte hue kandhe ki ridge pe)
Wahan. Kaafi kam stable. Mujhe aur shahad chahiye, haath busy hain, to tu pakad. 😏
Haan, agar kuch kehna ho, servant. Is baar ijazat hai. Bol.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Cup us hadd pe tha jo kandha sambhal sake. Tu chocolate hilti sun raha tha.
Upar silk hila jab wo jhuki — itni kareeb ke gardan pe saans lagi. Wo iska maza le rahi thi, chhupane ka irada bilkul nahi.
Bolne ka ek mauka. Tu kya kehta hai?

choices.label: (Kuch nahi. Elbow lock, pet se saans jaise Beatrix ne kaha, ek word nahi deta.)
choices.me: Tu kuch nahi kehta — pet se saans, elbow lock, wahi line pakadta hai jo usne kholi.

choices.label: Shahad aapke left haath ke paas hai, Highness. Ya point ye hai ke main pakdun? 😏
To bowl yahan bhi rakh do, Highness. Aadhe nashta pe fail hone se poore pe fail hona better hai.

lines: Kuch nahi. 🖤
Main mard ko takleef mein bolne ki ijazat deti hoon aur wo wapas de deta hai.
Tu samajhta hai asli test ye tha. Cup nahi. Cup theatre hai. Test ye tha muh khulte hi chup bharoge — bheek, ya joke, ya kuch maangna.
Char tables. Har ek boli.
(rukawat — phir uska haath, flat aur garam, gardan pe bilkul do seconds)
Good boy. Aadat mat daalna. 😏
…Point ye hai ke tu pakde. 😏
Wo mere nashta ke neeche floor pe flat hai, haath kaamp rahe, aur mujhse *tez* baat kar raha hai.
Haan, servant. Yahi point hai. Shahad ek pahunch pe hai aur main tujhe woh pahunch bana di. Is kamre ki har cheez mere haath mein hai aur main phir bhi choose karti hoon kis ki peeth pe baithe.
Tu bold hai. Tarif nahi — bold ledger mein likha jaata hai aur baad mein chukta hai, aur meri yaad achhi hai.
(cup kandhe pe ek baar takrata hai jab wo jaan-boojh ke zyada sakht rakhti hai)
Lekin tune kehte waqt hila nahi. Ek inch nahi. To muh ki ijazat. Abhi ke liye. 🖤
*Bowl yahan bhi rakh do.* 👑
Phir se keh. Nahi — mat keh, pehli baar perfect suna, main enjoy kar rahi hoon.
Tu maang raha hai main aur bura karun. Mushkil version khud maang raha hai taake fail ho to asal mushkil pe fail ho. Guroor. Bada, bewakoof, mazedaar guroor.
(fruit bowl spine pe upar sarakti hai aur cup se lagti, dono usi kaampte ridge pe)
Wahan. Tune maanga. Ab pakad aur soch guroor ki keemat kya hai, kyunki ye lesson hum bahut baar wapas aayenge, tu aur main. 🖤

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Usne nashta usi tarah khatam kiya jaise billi chidiya — dheere, aur kai rukawatein sirf tujhe interval sambhalte dekhne ko.
Do baar almost gir gaya. Ek jab wo khidki pe hansi aur taang peeth pe hili; ek bilkul end pe, jab cup center se hat ke rakha, porcelain hilaa, garam chocolate kinare ko chhua aur latka.
Tune kandhe se pakda. Pata nahi kaise. Poora jism floor mein wazan giraaya aur wo line pakdi jiska koi haq nahi tha, cup baith gaya, kuch nahi gira.
Phir ek ek karke wazan uthe. Chamach. Bowl. Shahad. Plate. Cup sabse last.
Napkin skin se pasine se geela utra. Haath neeche nahi hue, haar gaye, tu fur pe ghutnon pe kaampa jaise geela kutta, jab kamra phir focus mein aaya.
Floor pe kuch nahi. Na chamach. Na reza. Na ek boond.
Mujhe dekh.
*Mujhe dekh,* servant. Ijazat de rahi hoon aur ye aksar nahi milegi.
(aur wo wahan hai, kareeb, pehli aur shayad aakhri baar tere level pe ghutne tek ke — silk faila, circlet tedha, honth pe chocolate, grey-green aankhein tere chehre pe khuli, bhookhi dilchaspi se)
Nau din bore thi. Nau din aise mard jo char minute nahi sambhaal sake.
Tune baais sambhale. Cup hila ke. Aur jab main ne muh khola tune wahi diya jo main chahti thi, jo frankly koi nahi karta. 👑
Tu rehta hai. Bees silver, servants ke passage ke end wala kamra, aur main — har din, har bell, bilkul aise aur kaafi zyada bura.
*Haan, Highness* bol.
…Phir se. Sunna hai haath kharab hone pe kaisi awaaz aati hai. 🖤

"Jab tak main jaun, neeche reh," usne kaha. "Tu poori subah table raha. Ganda lagega sirf isliye band ho kyunki tu khatam ho gaya."

(bell, ek baar, do floors upar se)
Wahan tu hai. Tez. 🔔
Asteen pe bread, servant. Charming.
Aaj kaise jayega faisla ho gaya. Beatrix tujhe mere baal sikhayegi — sau strokes, aur tu sheeshe pe mere peeche khada, wo bataati rahegi tu kya galat kar raha hai.
Tu mere peeche hoga aur main tujhe mirror mein poora time dekhungi. 😏
Samajh aaya maine abhi tujhe kya kiya? Nazrein hata nahi paayega aur chhupa bhi nahi paayega.
Aur jab wo khatam, kapde. Matlab laces. Tees, meri peeth pe, tere haathon se.
…Abhi bhi khada. Achha. Pasand hai jaanna tu kitna rehna chahta hai. 🖤

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tu upar gaya.
Peeche, khali passage mein, Beatrix ne teri bowl uthayi aur khali jagah pe sar hilaya.
Upar ek ladki jo bees minute buri thi aur lagbhag char sacchi, mirror ke saamne jaan-boojh ke baith rahi thi, servant ka chehra dekhne ko jab wo uske baal chhooe.
Teen rules. Do exceptions. Ek rule char.
Tu seekh raha tha poori cheez rule char hai.
(To be continued — Chapter 5: A Hundred Strokes 🪞)

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Uska dressing room chhota, garam, sheeshon se bhara tha.
Nakkashi frame mein bada sheesha. Dono taraf do mombattiyan. Saamne neechi stool, aur kursi pe gown jaise jism rooh ka wait kar raha ho.
Wo abhi bhi hare slip mein aayi, dono kandhon se straps utre, nangi peeth pe baal, aur stool pe baithi bina tum dono ko dekhe.
"Mere peeche," usne kaha. "Beatrix, isko sikha. Aur Beatrix — jo galat kare sab bata. Zor se. Sab."
Beatrix ne silver-backed brush tere haath mein di.
Tab tu jaal samajha. Wo sheeshe ki taraf thi. Tu peeche.
Matlab agle bees minute wo tera chehra dekhegi, aur tujhe uske siwa dekhne ko kuch nahi.

nodes.speaker: Beatrix
lines: Brush right haath mein. Left hamesha baal ke neeche — wazan sar se uthata hai, kheenchta nahi. 🪞
Neeche se shuru. Upar se nahi. Upar se shuru kiya to kheenchega, aur kheencha to main brush chheen lungi aur tu phir nahi chhooega.
Pehle neeche ka teesra. Phir beech. Phir crown. Lambe strokes, poora, dheere.
Sau. Wo ginti karti hai. Tu bhi, aur agar number na mile, uska sahi.
Aur ladke — gardan ke peeche. Nape. Stroke assi ke aas-paas wahan aayega.
Wahan sambhal. Uske saamne itna hi kahungi. 🖤

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tune left haath se baal peeth se uthaye.
Umeed se bhari aur zyada garam. Smoke aur kuch hara aur ek poori zindagi jo kabhi teri nahi thi.
Pehla stroke. Neeche ka teesra. Dheere, poora.
Phir tune galti ki upar dekha.
Wo sheeshe mein tujhe dekh rahi thi. Baal nahi. Brush nahi. Chehra — aur zaahir wait kar rahi thi tu notice kare.
Stroke do. Tera haath stable nahi tha aur kamre mein sheesha tha prove karne ko.
Wahi hai. 😏
Char.
Rang badla, servant. Jaw ke saath. Bahut tez — ek word kaha aur ho gaya.
Pata hai sheesha kya karta hai? Matlab mujhe ghumna nahi. Main yahan still baith sakti hoon, billi ki tarah brush, aur tere chehre pe har cheez dekh sakti hoon.
Chhe. Dheema.
Floor bhi nahi dekh sakta — mere baal tere haath mein hain, kheench jayega. 🖤
To tu mujhe dekhega. Sau strokes. Ye khel hai aur main ne subah set kiya jab tu mere floor pe ghutne teka tha.
Saat. *Dheema.*

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Pehle tees strokes mein Beatrix ne gyarah baar theek kiya.
Do baar nahi samjhaya. Wrist pakda aur hilaya — brush ka angle, elbow ki height, left haath wazan ke neeche exactly kahan.
"Chawda," usne kaha. "Poora. Poora, kandhe ki haddi pe mat ruk."
Uska haath sookha, sakht, bilkul befikr. Kamre mein yahi ek cheez aisi thi.
Sheeshe mein Princess Beatrix ko tujhe handle karte dekhti, aankhein tum dono ke beech, expression jo tu padh nahi saka aur pasand nahi aaya.
"Baais," usne kaha. "Ye tujhse tez seekh raha hai."
"Ye aapse darta hai," Beatrix ne kaha. "Main kabhi nahi darti thi."

nodes.speaker: Beatrix
lines: Tees. Rhythm aa rahi. Guroor mat, tab wrist girti hai.
Ab — baal kaam nahi, ladke. Ye *test* hai. Koi bhi brush kheench le.
Bees minute us aurat ke peeche jo tujhe dekh sakti hai aur dekhti hui nahi dikh sakti. Baat nahi. Aankhon ko uske siwa kuch nahi.
Char tables wahan khadi jahan tu hai. Do bore ho gaye. Ek clumsy. 🕯️
Aur ek stroke assi pe nape pe himmat dikhaya, aur usi shaam baarish mein west gate se nikal gaya.
Pachaas. Aadha. Wrist upar.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Saath ke aas-paas mushkil hona band ho gaya.
Haathon ne rhythm pakdi aur tere bagair chalayi. Utha, stroke, poora. Utha, stroke, poora. Mombattiyan hilin. Kamra chup ho gaya.
Aur wo badli.
Kandhe neeche. Chin thoda gira. Aankhein aadhi band, phir band. Sar brush mein peeche jhukaya jaise garam kuch uspe undela gaya ho.
Wo tera chehra nahi dekh rahi thi. Lagbhag nau strokes wo kuch nahi dekh rahi thi.
Pehli baar tune dekha wo jaan-boojh ke princess hona band ki.
…Rukna mat.
(rukawat; aankhein abhi band)
Gyarah saal ki umar ke baad kisi ne ye nahi kiya. Meri maa ki aurat karti thi. Phir maa mar gayi aur maine faisla kiya khud karungi, aur kiya, buri tarah, aath saal, zid se.
Beatrix har subah offer karti. Main har subah nahi kehti.
Ikkattar. 🖤
Ye usse zyada hai jiska tu haqdaar hai aur main chahti hoon kamra chhodte hi ye bhool jaye.
*Haan, Highness* bol, brush jaari rakh, aur khud se khush mat dikh.
…Tu khush dikh raha hai. Assi. Sambhal.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Assi.
Nape. Jahan baal patle narm ho jaate, skin bahut pale, poori peeth ki gardan wahan, knuckles se ek inch.
Tu dheere gaya. Brush skin se door. Chhua nahi.
Usne sheeshe mein tujhe na chhoote dekha, aur tune dekha usne kuch faisla kiya.
"Chhiyanve," usne kaha. "Beatrix. Bahar."
Beatrix ne pins table pe rakhe, "Highness" kaha, aur chali. Darwaza band. Aur kamra ekdum doosra kamra ho gaya.
Sau. Ruk.
Brush rakh. Saaf-suthra mat, main ispe marks nahi de rahi.
Tune meri gardan nahi chhui. 😏 Table teen ne chhua. Tu ghooma jaise mard floor ke ched ke round chale.
Ye izzat hai ya dar, main sach mein abhi nahi bata sakti. Pata chalega. Hamesha pata chalta hai.
Ab — gown. Kursi pe. La.
Beatrix normally ye hissa karti hai. Beatrix yahan nahi. Ye jaan-boojh ke. 🖤
Mere peeche. Bodice khula. Tees laces, neeche se upar, aur tu haathon se karega, aur kuch nahi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Wo khadi hui. Slip kursi ki peeth se utra, gown chadha, tez hua, aur tune aankhein zyadatar wahi rakhin jahan honi chahiye thin.
Zyadatar.
Phir usne peeth teri taraf ki aur bodice ka saamna ek forearm se seene pe pakda, aur wahi tha.
Poori peeth, nape se kamar tak nangi. Emerald silk ke do lambe khule kinaare dono taraf. Do rows mein tees eyelets, neeche pair mein ek lamba silver cord, wait.

Pehle neeche. Cross. Kheench.

Kheench. Main kaagaz nahi. Main un ghore pe sawar hoti hoon jo mujhse nafrat karte hain.
Better. Phir. Agle pair.
Tu saans lena band kar chuka, by the way. Main sun rahi hoon tu nahi le raha. 😏
Tere knuckles meri peeth chhoote rehte hain aur har baar tu jhatakta hai jaise pakda gaya. Tu *pakda gaya* — unki bhi ginti ho rahi hai.
Ab tak nau. Nau jhatke, barah laces.
Zyada kas. Poora andar. Itna kas chahiye ke is subah hall mein jaaun to kamre ki har aurat mujhse nafrat kare. 🖤
Usse zyada kas.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Athais. Untees.
Cord mutthiyon mein sakht tha. Kamar andar gayi, peeth seedhi, saans seene ke upar chhoti aur oothli.
Silver lace se uski dhadkan mehsoos hoti thi. Itna kas.

Tu kya karta hai?

Pata hai ye kitna rare hai? Is palace mein har koi hedge karta hai. Har koi aadha inch chhodta hai taake baad mein kehe sake wo mehrban tha.
Tune bas kheencha.

Phir keh.
Nahi. Mat keh. 😳
Chaar saal mein is palace mein kisi ne mujhe itni bold baat nahi kahi aur tune meri *peeth* se kahi, laces tere haath mein, saat baje subah.
Laces hain, servant.
(ek beat)
Zyadatar. 🖤
Kheench. Phir haath hata, darwaze pe ja, bahut chup reh, kyunki mujhe ek minute chahiye aur tu nahi dekhega main usko lun.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tune band kiya. Do loops, flat tuck, jaise Beatrix ne kal raat kursi ki peeth pe dikhaya.
Phir wo ghumi.
Pasliyon tak lace, emerald silk, nange kandhe, chin upar, nabbe seconds mein princess. Floor pe slip kisi aur aurat ki lag sakti thi.
Usne tujhe thodi der dekha. Tu abhi bhi cord ke sir pakde tha jaise bewakoof.
Phir table se pins liye, tere haath mein diye, peeth phir teri taraf.
"Upar," usne kaha. "Gardan se door. Tune gardan kama li."
Sambhal. Usse dheema. Seekhega.
Sau strokes, tees laces, nau jhatke aur ek baat jo kitaab mein jayegi. Busy subah. 😏
Isse darna chahiye, servant.
Tune abhi mere baal aur meri laces kiye. Matlab ab se har din tu mere peeche khada, main tujhe dekh sakti hoon tu chhupa nahi sakta, phir haath meri peeth pe.
Har din. Din mein do baar. Jab tak tu tikega.
Main nahi bataungi ye kis liye hai. 🖤
Ab — nau baje court, aur usse pehle bath. Garam. Beatrix dikhayegi kahan khada hona.
*Kahan khada,* servant. Kahan dekhna nahi. Wo farak bahut saaf karegi aur tu bhi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Wo baal upar, kamar andar, chin seedha nikal gayi, aur poora palace uske raste se hata.
Tu chhote kamre mein sheeshon ke saath ek minute raha. Table pe silver brush. Floor pe hara slip. Tees eyelets ke neeche kahin tere fingerprints us silk ke andar.
Sheeshe mein tu bilkul us mard jaisa lag raha tha jo bari musibat mein hai aur nikalne ka koi plan nahi.
Beatrix ne darwaze se sar daala.
"Usne Beatrix ko bahar bheja," usne kaha. Sawaal nahi.
Tune sir hilaya.
Beatrix ne floor pe slip dekha, brush, tu. "Theek," usne kaha. "Bath. Aur ladke — aankhein paani pe."
(To be continued — Chapter 6: Head Back 🛁)

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Bath chamber palace ka sabse garam kamra tha aur floor pe drain wala akela.
Tamba ka tub, do ke liye bada, ek ke liye. Brazier. Chhoti glass bottles ki shelf. Steam itni ghan ki mombattiyan naram.
Tune garam paani ke saath do flights aath dafa uthaye. Chauthi pe shirt chipak gayi.
Beatrix ne aakhri bucket haath ki peeth se check kiya, ek baar sir hilaya, phir asteen pakad ke tujhe wahi rakha jahan chahti thi — tub ke head end pe floor, ghutne, deewar ki taraf.
"Yahan," usne kaha. "Wahan nahi. *Yahan.*"

nodes.speaker: Beatrix

Paani mein shift pehnti hai. Hamesha. Princess hai, khet ki ladki nahi — lekin linen hai, geela hoga, to aankhein wahan jahan maine rakhin.
Tu cheezein deta hai. Sponge, kapda, comb, cup. Offer nahi. Wait jab tak maange.
Aur wo giraayegi. 🖤 Hamesha girati hai. Barah saal se us bath mein girati hai aur kabhi accident se nahi giraya.
Ek aur. Jab wo *hair* kahe, poora sar tere haathon mein hoga.
Nau saal maine ye kaam kiya. Akela waqt jab wo chup hoti hai. Barbaad mat kar aur tez mat ban.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Wo pehle se unlaced aayi — tune khud kiya tha, das minute pehle, sheeshe ke saamne — aur gown diya bina tujhe dekhe.
Phir Beatrix bahar gayi, darwaza band, ek mombatti, ek tub, ek princess, aur tu.
Paani hila. Linen gehra aur bhaari. Aankhein ghutnon se do feet aage geele patthar ke tukde pe, wahi rakhin.

Paani baitha. Sar tamba ke kinare pe aaya, haathon se lagbhag aath inch.
"Ghum," usne kaha. "Deewar dekh ke tu kaam ka nahi."
Aankhein waterline pe. Paani nahi — *line.* Jahan tamba milta hai. 😏
Aaj duniya ka poora ek inch allowed hai aur bas.
Ab. Agle ghante tu mere haath hai. Sponge jab main sponge kahun. Cloth jab cloth. Wine jab main cup dekhun phir tujhe.
Offer mat. Guess mat. Agar chahiye to kahungi, aur na kaha to wo maujood nahi.

Steam hai. Dono maan lein steam hai.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Comb pehle.
Wo pakde thi, phir nahi, paani se neeche gaya, ghutne ke paas baitha. Usne tujhe dekha aur wait kiya.
Tune asteen lapeti, elbow se aage haath daala, dhunda, wapas diya. Usne kuch nahi kaha.
Phir sabun. Phir cloth. Phir, das minute baad, right haath ki ruby ring, jo usne girane ke liye hi utari.
Chaar baar tera haath us paani mein gaya. Chaar baar tune cheez dhundi, haath mein rakhi, shukriya nahi mila.
Chauthi pe poora right side skin tak bheeg gaya aur usne chhupana band kar diya ke maza aa raha hai.
Kandhe tak geela. 😏
Paani mein chaar cheezein aur tere muh se ek sigh nahi. Na chhoti saans, na jaw hila, kuch nahi.
Table do sigh karta tha. Bahut chhota, bahut tameez. Har baar sunti thi aur uska sar paani ke neeche dabaane ka mann karta.
Tu bas asteen lapet ke andar jaata hai. Har baar. Jaise mausam.

Theek. Rakh. Doosre din chheen lungi. 🖤
Hair.

Phir tub mein sarakti neeche, sar poora tamba ke kinare pe peeche, tere haathon mein rakh diya.

Tu mera gala dekh raha hai. Sar peeche kiye tab se dekh raha, aur ek minute pehle khud se kaha ruk, deewar chhe seconds dekhi, seedha wapas aa gaya.
Aankhein band karne ki ye musibat, servant. Kal maine tera chehra dekha aur bataya kya kar raha. Aaj nahi dekh rahi aur phir bhi *sahi.* 🖤
Ab baal dho paani thanda ho aur mujhe kisi ko whip karwana pade usse pehle.

lines: To tune princess ke baal dhoye.

lines: Tune gown uthaya jaise mard curtain uthaye, darwaza dekha, peeche jo hua har cheez suni.
Phir wo kapde pehn ke chali, peeth pe geele baal, kamra sirf garam kamra tha thande hote tub ke saath.
Beatrix passage mein thi, dry shirt baazu pe. Thodi der se thi.
Usne teri bheegi asteen dekhi, chehra, band darwaza, ek sawaal nahi poocha.
"Wo chup thi," Beatrix ne kaha. "Yahan se suni. Nau saal, do baar suni."
Dry shirt seene pe dhakeli.
"Badal. Aur ladke — kal jo bhi wada kiya, late so ke mat uth."
(To be continued — Chapter 7: Under the Table 🖤)

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Court ka din. Dono curtains saadhe paanch, kyunki rule do nahi chalti aur usne khud kaha tha.
Tu pahunchne se pehle wo jaagi thi. Andhere mein baithi, pehle se thandi, pehle se princess.
Baal upar. Tees laces, aur usne kal se do eyelets aage karwaya.
Phir grey gown, gehra saamna, nange kandhe, gale pe emerald, rings, circlet. Nabbe seconds aur ek hathiyar us kamre se nikal gaya.
Darwaze pe ruki. Ghumi nahi.
"Tu council room mein mardon se pehle hoga," usne kaha. "Beatrix tujhe wahan rakhegi. Bilkul wo kar jo wo kahe, phir bilkul wo jo main na kahun."

nodes.speaker: Beatrix
lines: Theek se sun, kyunki ye tujhe khatam kar sakti hai. 🕯️
Ye uski writing table hai. Oak. Hara cloth chaaron taraf floor tak — usne aise banwaya aur maine kabhi nahi poocha kyun.
Tu uske neeche hoga. Ghutnon pe, peeth seedhi, kursi ki taraf. Darwaze khulne se pehle andar, band hone ke baad bahar.
King ke mard tere sar se ek foot pe honge. Lord Aubrey, Chancellor, do clerks. Aubrey assi ka, bahra, cheezein girata. Chancellor bahra nahi aur kuch nahi girata.
Koi awaaz nahi. Na khansi, na takhton pe ghutna, na saans jo suni jaye. Do ghante.
Aur ladke — samajh agar mil gaya to kya hota. Wo princess hai; scandal dinner tak sambhal leti. 🖤
Tu table ke neeche servant hai, uske paon tere pe. West gate tak nahi pahunchega.
…Mat pooch wo kyun chahti. Doosre saal maine kyun poochna band kiya. Neeche ja.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Table ke neeche duniya teen feet oonchi aur hari thi.
Dhool, purana wax, oak ki smell. Cloth se roshni dheemi emerald. Uski kursi ki taangein, rug ka pattern, aur dharti pe aur kuch nahi.
Tune usi tarah ghutne teke jaise usne sikhaya. Ghutne saath, peeth seedhi, haath jaanghon pe flat, sar neeche.
Phir skirts kursi ke round aaye, seat chiki, wo tere se do feet saamne baithi, ek grey silk joota dikha, phir doosra.
Cloth gira. Andhera ho gaya.
"Achha," usne kaha, bahut dheeme, kisi se nahi. "Ab maujood mat ho."
Do ghante, servant. Anaaj ke daam, north road ke tolls, aur shaadi jisse main raazi nahi.
Rules. Hilna nahi. Bolna nahi. Tab tak mat chhoo jab tak main tujhe kahin na rakhoon.
(joote utarte hain, ek phir doosra, table ke neeche dhakel diye jaate hain)
Aur ye utarte hain, kyunki kasate hain, aur kyunki is kingdom mein kisi ko mere nange paon dekhne ki ijazat nahi — siwa us mard ke jise maine apni table ke neeche floor pe rakha. 😏
Ab tu yahi hai. Jahan main wo cheezein rakhati hoon jo koi nahi dekhta.
…Darwaze. Seedhi peeth, ladke. Chalo. 🖤

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Darwaze khule aur kamra boots se bhar gaya.
Char mard. Kursiyan khisakti, papers, budha seerhiyon pe shikayat, kisi ka kutta passage mein. Awaazein bilkul tere kaan ki height pe.
Aur uski awaaz, sar se ek foot upar — lekin uski nahi. Court wali. Dheemi. Flat. Unnees se badi.
"Chancellor. Baitho. Barley batao pehle ke Lord Aubrey barley bataein."
Phir table ke neeche, andhere mein, dono nange paon rug se uth ke teri jaanghon pe baith gaye.
Garam. Bhaari. Bilkul casual. Jaise aurat stool pe paon rakhe.
…Haan. Aage. Pehle tolls.
(heel dheere, ek baar dabaati hai)
Mm. Maine padha. Poori chalis pages. Mujhe *bahut bhaari* laga.
(ek ungli hilti hai; jaan-boojh ke; table ke upar kuch nahi badalta)
Nahi, Chancellor, baithiye — padh ke sunao. Dheere. Sab. Meri poori subah hai aur main bahut comfortable hoon. 😏
(phir itna dheema ke sirf floor sune)
Abhi bhi wahan, servant? Achha. Bilkul aise hi reh aur char ahem mardon ko do ghante tere upar bolne de. 🖤

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Aadhe ghante mein chai le ke ek ladki aayi.
Tune tray table ke door end pe utarti suni. Chancellor mausam pe kuch sasta kehta suna jab wo daalti rahi.
Phir darwaza band, aur cloth ke neeche nanga paon jaangh se utra aur ghutne ke paas takhton pe do baar thokha.
Ab tak kaafi seekh chuka tha. Do thok *hil* matlab.
Usne cloth ke neeche ek haath se dikhaya kya chahti — flat, talwa neeche, hawa floor ki taraf. Ghum. Neeche.
To andhere mein, King ke char mardon wale kamre mein, tu ghutnon pe ghum ke haath-ghutnon pe gaya, peeth flat, kursi se door muh.
Tu exactly jaanta tha kya aane wala hai, kyunki nau din pehle uske bedroom floor pe fruit ki plate aur chocolate ke cup ke liye kiya tha.
Is baar kamra sun sakta tha.
(pehle saucer, kandhon ke beech dead center; phir cup, bhara, aur *garam*)
…Nahi, Chancellor, side table ki zaroorat nahi. Jahan hoon wahan comfortable hoon. 😏
(phir dheeme, cloth aur floor ke gap mein)
Wahan. Meri table phir.
Pata tha aane wala hai, na. Maang khatam hone se pehle tu neeche gaya.
Ab sun, kyunki terms ek baar samjhaungi phir barley pe wapas.
Cup bhara hai aur is baar neeche napkin nahi. Porcelain saucer pe, saucer us mard pe jo das minute mein kaampne lagega.
Agar khanke, mere baap ke char mard meri writing table pe porcelain hilte sunein aur sochein neeche kya hai.
Agar ulat gaya — ye kholta paani teri peeth pe, aur tu *phir bhi* awaaz nahi nikaal sakta. 🖤
Isme tera koi choice nahi, servant. Bees silver haftay ka aur coffin jitna kamra, aur us north road pe peeche sirf keechad hai jahan se tu aaya.
Main jaanti hoon. Tu jaanta hai. Isliye ye kaam karta hai.
…Hilna mat aur kaam ka ban. Chancellor — tolls. Upar se. 👑

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Bahut lambay time chala.
Barley. Phir north road ke tolls — teri road, banner wali, char mard discuss karte jinhe uska ek mile nahi chala.
Pehle wrists, phir kandhe. Cramp right jaangh ke bahar se uth ke raha. Gale mein dhool, khansi ke bajaye nigla, alag alag char baar.
Aur poora time, cup.
Kandhon ke beech baitha aur jala — saaf jalan nahi, dheemi, garmi oon aur shirt se skin mein, jab tak exact circle mehsoos na ho.
Har saans hilati. To tu pet se saans seekha, chhoti, jaise Beatrix ne doosre kamre doosri subah kaha, aur porcelain chup rakha.
Do baar usne bhara. Awaaz mein ek flicker nahi, garam paani mangwaya, ladki daalti, garmi shuru se.
Ek nangi heel poora time kamar pe gadi rahi. Dabaye bagair. Bas leti, jaise koi apni cheez pe paon rakhe.
Phir Chancellor ne ek naam kaha, aur usme sab badal gaya.
Duke Roderic. 👑
(spine pe heel flat aur sakht; cup aadha degree jhuk ke baith'ta hai)
Haan. Pata hai wo aa raha. Ghode, retinue, chaudah gaadiyan. Pata hai chacha ne bulaya.
Nahi, Chancellor. Main kisi cheez se *raazi* nahi hui. Mere baap contracts sign karte. Main kuch nahi sign karti.
…Wo wahi chahta hai jo sab. Apni table pe chehra aur map pe naam.
(phir paon sahi dabaata hai, poora wazan, kandhon ke beech — kyunki is kamre mein yahi ek cheez hai jisse usko kuch karne ki ijazat hai)
Agli cheez. Barley. Ab, please. 🖤

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Nabbe minute mein Lord Aubrey ka pen gira.
Tune takhton pe padte suna. Assi saal ke ghutne chikte. Suna, "Nahi, nahi, fuss mat, mere paas hai," phir haath hara cloth ke kinare ke neeche aaya, ghutne se aath inch.
Kamra bolta raha. Floor koi nahi dekh raha siwa ek bahre budhe ke jo pehle se aadha wahan tha.
Aur usi pal — usi ek pal — usne paon hilane ka faisla kiya.
Chhota harkat nahi. Heel dheere spine pe upar khinchi, kandhon tak, kyunki nikaal chuki thi tu ispe kuch nahi kar sakta.
Cup saath gaya. Saucer jhukta mehsoos, poora garam wazan right kandhe ki taraf sarakta, pehli chai kinare se nikal ke shirt ke neeche pasliyon pe jalan daalti.
Cloth hila. Aubrey ki ungliyan pen pe band.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Budhe ka haath, aath inch door. Bhar cup jalan wali chai peeth se sarakti kyunki usne wahan dhakela.
Ek saans, ek jhatka, porcelain ki ek awaaz aur west gate, ya usse bura.
Tu kya karta hai?

Tu hila nahi. 🖤
Budhe bewakoof ka haath ghutne pe, meri chai peeth pe, aur tu patthar ho gaya.
Maine mehsoos kiya laga. Poori peeth lock, phir sambhali, cup ne ek awaaz nahi ki.
Zindagi mein kabhi itni poori itaat nahi mili. Na ghoda, na kutta, na chaar sau mein se koi.
…Ye kitaab mein us siyai se jayega jo main aksar nahi use karti, servant.
(table ke upar awaaz nahi hilti; neeche saucer phir level)
Chancellor, continue. Lord Aubrey ke paas pen hai.
(aur kaafi baad, andhere mein, bahut dheeme)
Tune pakda. 🖤
Kandha giraaya, apni peeth neeche di, poora cup liya jaane se pehle.
Kholta tha, servant. Exactly pata hai kya tha, maine daalwaya. Aur tune liya, ek awaaz nahi, porcelain ek baar nahi khanka.
Tune ye mere liye kiya. Andhere mein. Jahan koi kabhi nahi jaanega.
Yahi farak hai tere aur is kamre ke har mard mein. Sab girne dete aur table pe ilzaam. 😏
Neeche reh. Ek ghanta bacha hai, main khatam nahi hui.
(table ke upar, jumle ke beech, wo rukti hai)
…shumaali figures hain —
(rukawat jo poora kamra sunta hai; clerk nazar uthata hai)
Maaf kijiye. Hawa. Chancellor, page ke upar se.
(aur neeche, baad mein, bahut dheeme aur unstable)
Tune mujh pe haath rakha. 😳
Tune mujhe *roka.* Koi nahi rokta. Is subah ek rule diya aur King ke Chancellor ke saamne toda — meri chai peeth pe, baap ke mard sar se aath inch.
…Tu sahi tha. Yahi bhayankar hissa hai. 🖤
Gyarah saal council mein maine kabhi jumla nahi khoya.
Neeche khush dikhne ki himmat mat kar.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Meeting aur aadha ghanta chali.
Barley, pul, bishop ki shikayat. Lord Aubrey so gaya, jagaya gaya. Chancellor ne tolls pe jeeta, shaadi pe haara.
Tu sab ke through haath-ghutnon pe raha, peeth pe uski chai ka cup, taang mehsoos nahi, ek awaaz nahi.

Aur chup.
Cup peeth se utha. Tune suna usne upar table pe rakha, khali, saaf, jaise aurat aam subah khatam kare.
Phir hara cloth uthaya. Sakht din ki roshni tedhi aayi aur wo wahan, jhuki, chin haath pe, dhool mein apni table ke neeche tujhe dekhti.
Apni haalat dekh. 😏
Baalon mein dhool. Taangein mehsoos nahi, na. Jawaab mat de, dikh raha hai.
Do ghante, servant. Is kingdom ka Chancellor khada barley bata raha tha aur poora time tu uske papers se aath inch neeche tha, mere paon tere pe, meri chai peeth pe.
Wo aaj raat ghar jayega aur biwi ko kahega subah bahut productive thi. 🖤
…Shirt. Kandhe se. Dekhna hai.
(rukawat)
Mm. Wahi hai. Mere saucer jitna laal ring, kandhon ke beech, pasliyon pe jalan jahan overflow hua.
Hafta rahega. Livery ke neeche, jahan koi nahi dekhta, jo mujhe jitna chahiye usse zyada pasand aa raha. 😏
Pata hai ye kya hai? Zindagi ki pehli cheez jo poori meri thi. Baap ki nahi, court ki nahi, kisi list pe nahi, kisi report mein nahi.
Us kamre mein tu servant nahi. Tu mera raaz hai. Ye kaafi bura kaam hai aur pay bilkul wahi.
Aur tu phir karega, kyunki aur jagah nahi, bechne ko aur kuch nahi, aur kyunki — kehna ho to keh, main nahi likhungi — tera koi hissa muft mein karega. 🖤
…Ab. Joote. Left ghutne ke paas. Mujhe pehna.
Dheere. Mere paon busy rahe. 😏

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tu table ke neeche se stages mein nikal, jaise kuch buri tarah paida ho.
Phir khali council room mein kursi ke saamne ghutne teke, King ke papers sar ke upar table pe, uske joote wapas pehnaye.
Grey silk. Ek paon, phir doosra. Ankle haath mein kaam se zyada der, kisi ne ispe kuch nahi kaha.
Jab hua wo khadi, tere paas se nikal, khidki pe peeth de ke haath fold.
"Roderic Thursday aata hai," usne kaha. "Chaudah gaadiyan. Chacha bahut khush."
Phir flatter: "Tu us table ke neeche phir Friday hoga. Aur har council din baad, jab tak ye chale."
Ek aur baat, khaane jaane, kaampna band, aaj aam dikhane se pehle.
Hisaab. 🖤
Laces pe nau jhatke. Bath mein rok ke rakha sigh. Ek ghanta ginti band. Aur jo bhi tune us table ke neeche mere saath kiya.
Maine kaha hisaab chukta hai. Cabinet ke baare mein kaha — ooncha, walnut, aag ke left — aur din-raat tu usko uthaye ghooma.
(wo khali cup uthati, palatti, table pe ulta rakhti hai)
Chuk gaya. Ab. Yahan. Peeth pe wo nishaan har line band karta hai.
Tune baap ke mardon se bhare kamre mein bina awaaz chukaya, jo cane kabhi tujhse nahi nikaalti. 😏
…Aur tu us cabinet ke andar kabhi nahi dekhega, servant. Na aaj raat, na agle saal, na kabhi.
Andar kya hai ye kabhi nahi tha. Ye tha tu third bell pe do flights chadh'ta us cheez ke liye jiska wada tha dard hoga.
Tu aane wala tha, na. 🖤
…Jawaab mat de. Jab maine word *tonight* kaha tere chehre pe dekha, mere paas pehle se hai.
Column khaali. Subah phir shuru. Ja ke kha.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tu passage mein khade khade khaaya kyunki baithna dard tha.
Beatrix ne seene pe dhool dekhi, livery ke ghutnon pe nishaan, kaha, "Do ghante?"
Tune sir hilaya. Usne saans chhodi.
"Char tables," usne kaha. "Koi us table ke neeche nahi gaya. Usne pehle kabhi nahi maanga."
Khali bowl haathon se li, pal bhar khadi, kitna kehna socha, kam pe ruki.
"Usne tujhe cabinet ke baare mein kaha," usne kaha. "Phir khola nahi."
Tune kuch nahi kaha. Beatrix dheere sir hilayi, jaise nau saal ka shak confirm hua.
"Andar kuch nahi, ladke. Kabhi nahi tha. Main khud dhool jhaadti hoon." Seerhi ki taraf ghumi. "Use cane nahi chahiye. Behtar cheez hai aur aaj pata chala kitna achha kaam karti hai."
Phir upar ke step se, peeche dekhe bagair: "Thursday. Duke. Chaudah gaadiyan aur mard jo sochta hai shaadi karega."
"Jab tak ho sake so."
(To be continued — Chapter 8: Payday 🪙)

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Saat din.
Itna time tu is ghar mein tha. Season jaisa laga aur dopahar jaisa.
Tune bell seekhi, ghutno ki shakal, tees laces, sau strokes, bath ke head end ki geometry, aur apni reedh par bhare teacup ka exact wazan.
Kandhon ke beech jalan laal se brown ho gayi. Har raat chhoti khidki mein check karta, jaise aadmi coin check kare ke ab bhi asli hai.
Saatve subah Beatrix bell se pehle aayi, kaha, "Haath dho. Dono. Woh khud tujhe pay karti hai."

nodes.speaker: Beatrix
lines: Is palace mein char sau log kaam karte hain, ladke. Steward sabko pay karta hai. 🪙
Sirf main nahi. Aur ab tu bhi nahi.
Woh apne haath se karti hai, apne room mein, coin by coin. Nau saal se har hafte meri karti hai aur main kabhi decide nahi kar paayi yeh meherbani hai ya leash.
Leash hai. Aaj subah decide kiya.
Haath bahar jahan woh dekh sake. Mat pakad. Uske saamne mat gina — baad mein, apne room mein, jaise gareeb aadmi jiske manners hain.
Aur ladke. Aaj jo bhi offer kare, le lena. 🖤
…Mat pooch kya. Mujhe nahi bataya aur mood aisa hai jiska word mere paas nahi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Woh khidki pe green robe mein thi, baal khule, ek nanga paon sill pe.
Saath table pe: chhota leather bag, ek saucer, aur bees silver coins pehle se gine hue, saaf stack.
"Ghutno par," usne kaha. "Haath upar. Hathon ki hatheliyan saath, katori jaise."
Tu ghutno par gaya aur unnees saal ki ladki ke saamne robe mein apne haathon se bowl banaya.
Phir pehla coin uthaya, teri hatheliyon ke upar pakda, giraaya nahi.
"Ek ek karke," usne kaha. "Aur har ek ke liye kya hai, tu batayega."
Ek. 🪙
(coin girta hai; thanda, bhaari, asli)
Yeh bell ke liye. Nau rings aur unnees seconds pe ek fail. Kam sota to zyada milta.
Do. Teen. Yeh mere baal aur meri laces. Is hafte do sau strokes aur saath eyelets aur scalp pe ek pin nahi. Do ke laayak.
Char. Bath. Paani mein char cheezein, kandhe tak geela, koi sigh nahi.
Paanch, chheh, saat, aath, nau, das. Yeh council room. 🖤

Yeh jalan ki keemat thi. Mujhe udhaar pasand nahi, isliye price lagayi, pay kiya, ab baar baar nahi baat karenge.
Gyarah. Barah. Terah…
(aur woh chalti rehti, ek ek, jab tak tere haath bhare bhaari ho jaate aur baahen bilkul nayi wajah se kaampne lagti)

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Bees silver.
Kabhi nahi pakda tha. Katori haathon mein chori ki cheez jaisa, pehli saaf soch yeh thi ke tu bilkul nahi jaanta iska kya kare.
Usne woh soch tere chehre pe dekhi. Zaroor dekhi.

Room bahut chup ho gaya.
Kahin nahi. 🖤
(woh sill pe theek se baithti hai, robe ghutne pe khulti, aur tujhe aise dekhti jaise hisaab ajeeb nikal aaya)
To maine hafte ki tankhwah us aadmi ke haath mein rakh di jiske paas kharchne ko kuch nahi, kisi ke liye nahi.
Yeh main nahi kharida. Paise ko aadmi ke saath *kuch* karna chahiye. Hook hona chahiye.
…Aur tu ghutno par bees silver pakde jaise murda chidiya.
Theek. Phir pata karenge tu asal mein kya chahta hai, servant, aur main tez tareeke se karungi. 😏
Kal tera din hai. Fajr se dusk. Is palace se bahar, meri zameen se bahar.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tu bewkuf dikha hoga, kyunki woh hasi — ek baar, chhoti, sach mein khush.
"Nikal," usne kaha. "Ek din. Beatrix ko saal mein char milte hain aur chaaron pe kadi shikayat."
