Servant jise kabhi bahar nahi milta qaid hai, qaid ajeeb ho jaate hain, aur main nahi chahti koi ajeeb cheez meri bath ke head end pe ghutno par.
Main aadmi chahti hoon jo ja sakta. 🖤
Warna kuch nahi keemat, samajh? Koi bhi bewakoof kamre mein kutta rakh sakta.
Fajr. Bahar. Aur din ke saath kuch kar, warna main jaanungi, aur itna disappointed houngi ke tu hafte bhar mehsoos karega.
*Mujhe wapas laa.* 😳
Mere floor pe ghutne, mere paise, aur princess se pooch raha market se kya laaye.
Kya kharidta mujhe, servant? Mere paas gyarah ghode. Is room mein heera hai teri poori gaon se mehnga.
(rukna; chehre ke peeche kuch hilta, woh hata deti)
Kuch nahi. Kuch mat laana. Stall ki cheez nahi chahiye us paise se jo maine diya — apna gift wapas aata hat pehenke. 🖤
Khud ko laana. Dusk se pehle. Poora kaam yahi hai.
…Aur agar kuch kharida, himmat na ho ke main dekhun. 😏
(coins table pe girte, roll, woh ek bhi nahi chhuti)
Yeh kya hai.
Nahi — pata hai kya hai. Tune meri taraf apni zindagi ka hafte wapas kiya point ke liye, aur point yeh ke paise tujhe yahan nahi rok rahe.
Sabse bold kaam kiya, servant, aur muh band karke. 🖤
Utha.
*Utha.* Har coin. Tera hai, tu lega, kyunki main woh aurat nahi banungi jise aadmi muft mil jaaye.
…Aur din bhi le. Dono. Main dressing gown mein sill pe deal nahi karti. 😤

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: To agle subah tu west gate se nikal gaya udhaar brown coat mein, boot mein bees silver, aur shehar ne aise liya jaise kabhi thooka nahi.
Bathhouse mein nahaaya, keemat us chai se kam jo usne peeth pe jalaayi. Shave kiya. Teen baar khaya, ganda aur bahut, ek baar baith ke.
Blanket kharida. Achha mota grey — kyunki Beatrix doosre blanket pe yakeen nahi rakhti aur tera room qabr tha, aur pehli cheez thi jo kisi aur ke galat hone ke liye kharidi.
North road ke upar thodi der khada raha.
Post dikha. Banner nahi — kisi ne utaara, ya hawa. Yahan se nau din kuch nahi, usne kaha tha, distance pe bilkul sahi.
Tu ghuma, shehar wapas aaya, aakhri cheez kharidi.
Ribbon. Green silk, stall se, aurat ne kaagaz mein lapeta kyunki sochi sweetheart ke liye hai.
Ek coin laga. Unnees bache, duniya mein pata nahi kya soch raha tha.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tu west gate pe dusk se do ghante pehle wapas tha.
Karte waqt pata tha galat hai. *Dusk se pehle nahi,* usne kaha tha, rules wali awaaz mein.
Khud se kaha passage mein intezaar. Nazar se door rahoonga.
Beatrix ne darwaze pe ek nazar dekha, baghal mein blanket, mutthi mein paper twist, aankhein band ki jaise aurat cart ko khadd mein jaate dekhe.
"Do ghante jaldi," usne kaha. "Tavern mein baith sakta tha. *Deewar* pe baith sakta tha."
Phir bell, do baar, sakht.
Usne aangan paar karte dekha apni khidki se. Zaroor dekha.
Do ghante. 🖤
Maine ek din diya. Ek. Fajr se dusk, poora rule yahi, aur mere peeche us khidki mein do ghante din khade hain.
Tere paas shehar tha. Paise. Nau din lambi road jiske end pe kuch nahi.
Aur tu *jaldi* aaya.
…Mat bata kyun. Awaaz mein nahi chahiye, aaj nahi.
(woh kareeb aati; blanket dekhti; munh hilta)
…Blanket. Us coffin room ke liye, kyunki Beatrix nahi deti aur tu do baar maangne se pehle khud kharid leta.
Aur doosre haath mein kya, servant? Darwaze se aate hi taang ke peeche pakde ho. 😏
Yahan de.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tune paper twist diya.
Usne hatheli pe khola — green silk ribbon ka ek tukda, market ka, ek coin, us room mein jahan heera hai.
Woh nahi hasi. Woh daraane wala hissa. Lambi nazar, phir do ungliyon pe dheere lapeta, phir haath band kiya.
"Ek coin," usne dheere kaha. "Bees mein se."
Phir khidki ki taraf ghumi, mutthi band, pal se zyada, aur jab wapas ghumi to chehre ke peeche sab rakh ke taala laga diya.
"Theek," usne kaha, awaaz silli, meethi, bilkul khatarnak. "Ab. Tune meri baat nahi maani."
Do ghante jaldi. Seedha order, dheere diya, meri aankhein tere pe. 🖤
Dekh, main *kyun* kiya ispe jhagda nahi karungi. Ab mera hai. Book mein hai, rahega.
Lekin order khada hai, order toota, aur is ghar mein char sau log khush honge sun ke meri rule us aadmi se toot sakti jisne mujhe ribbon kharida.
To kal tu jawab dega.
Koi tez nahi. Chai wali nahi. 😏
Mere chamber mein tapestry aur khidki ke beech deewar ka hissa. Khali patthar. Tune kabhi nahi dekha.
Kal, nashta ke baad, tu uspe khada, naak lagi, baahen bahar, ek ghanta, aur mere paas company hogi.
…Livery pehen. Naye blanket ke neeche so. Goodnight, servant. 🖤

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Pehli baar palace mein garam soya, cheating jaisa laga.
Unnees silver spare boot ke toe mein cot ke neeche, aur tu andhere mein grey oon ke neeche hisaab karta raha.
Azaadi ka ek din. Khuli road. Do ghante muft wapas, us aurat ko jisne teri jalan das silver pe price ki aur market ribbon mutthi mein rakh li jaise saboot.
Passage mein peetal ki bell bracket pe chup.
Tune socha khali deewar tapestry aur khidki ke beech, aur *mere paas company hogi*, aur blanket jitna deserve karta utna nahi soya.
(To be continued — Chapter 9: The Wall 🧱)

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Usne nashta us table pe kiya jiski taangein thin, jo bura ishara laga.
Tu darwaze pe khada, usko khate dekha, bees minute ek word nahi. Na nazar. Na order. Kuch nahi.
Phir cup rakha, munh pooncha, tapestry aur khidki ke beech patthar pe ungli ki, sir ghumaaye bagair.
"Wahan," usne kaha. "Pata hai kyun."
Pata tha kyun. Do ghante din aur green ribbon.
Deewar thandi grey patthar, uske khandaan se purani, tu chalis baar guzra bina dekhe.
Naak uspe. Theek se — chhu ke. Agar tere chehre aur meri deewar ke beech din dikha to ghanta phir se shuru. 🖤
Paon saath. Baahen seedhi sides pe, kandhon ke barabar, hatheliyan patthar pe chhapti.
…Yeh. Ise pakad.
Ek ghanta. Move nahi, bol nahi, ghum nahi, baahen neeche nahi. Girin to main kahungi aur ghanta phir shuru.
Tu jaanna chahega yeh cane se zyada kharab kyun. 😏
Yeh kuch nahi ka ghanta, servant, garam room mein, us aurat ke teen feet peeche jo bahut comfortable hogi. Bas. Poori saza.
…Aur das minute mein company aati. Lady Mirren. Court se.
Woh jaanna chahegi tu kya hai. Maine decide kiya tu deewar hai. 🖤

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Pehle das minute kuch nahi. Naak ke sire pe thanda patthar, baahen bahar, aasaan.
Doosre das baahen thin.
Koi baahon ke baare mein nahi batata. Level pakde, haath khaali, theek se garam, phir jalan, phir gehra khinchta dard kalaai se gardan tak. Atharah minute pe kandhe kaampe, kuch kar nahi sakta tha.
Peeche usne page palaata. Kuch dala. Kursi hilaayi.
Room mein uski khushbu, har kaam suna, aur chheh sau saal ke patthar ka ek square foot dekha.
Phir darwaza, chamak awaaz, silk ki rustle usse do guna tez.

nodes.speaker: Lady Mirren
lines: Cassandra, darling, bahar *thand* hai aur tere uncle ke logon ne mujhe north stair pe rakha jaise parcel—
Oh.
Teri deewar mein aadmi khada hai. 🙊
Nahi, mat bata. Theek se dekhne de. Livery. Kandhe. Baahen scarecrow jaisi, bechara, aur kaamp bhi raha.
Yeh naya hai? Jise Beatrix ne road pe paaya? Sabne suna, jaanti ho. Poora south wing suna.
…Ghum, ladke, chehra dikha. Chal. 😏
Woh nahi ghumega. 🖤
Baith, Mirren. Wine hai. Isse mat bol.
Aaj subah yeh *woh* nahi, yeh deewar hai, aur patthar se baat nahi karte.
…Nahi, har word sun raha. Humein perfectly sun raha. Exercise ka point yahi hai.
(kursiyan; wine; aag)
Kya kiya? Jaldi ghar aaya. 😏
…Haan. Bas itna. Maine din off diya, do ghante pehle khud wapas laaya.
To woh deewar mein hai. Ab apni sister ki shaadi bata, pehle ke main iske baare mein aur sochun.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: To tu chheh sau saal ke patthar mein khada, do auratein peeche chaar feet, gyarah baje subah wine peeti sunta raha.
Lambi chali.
Shaadi. Kisi ka ruswa bhai. Bishop jisne topi pe maafi ke laayak nahi kaha. Court ke kaun keemat rakhte, kaun kuch nahi se kam — list Lady Mirren ne bade maza aur kaafi detail se di.
Iktees minute pe baahen deewar se takraayin. Usne kaha, "Upar," jumla rok ke nahi, tu uthaya.
Phir Mirren shaadi se bore hui, room ki interesting cheez pe wapas aayi.
"Cassandra," usne kaha, bilkul doosri awaaz. "Chal. Woh tera hai?"

nodes.speaker: Lady Mirren
lines: Aise mat dekh. Sab karte hain. Court ki aadhi ladies ke paas ladka hai jo baal, laces aur *et cetera* karta, koi word nahi kehta.
Mera Tomas hai. Post jaisa dull lekin peeth darwaze jaisi. 😏
…Tera road se aaya, kuch nahi, kehte. Woh achha type. Wapas jaane ko kuch nahi, sauda karne ko kuch nahi.
(kareeb; kursi dhakelne ki awaaz; skirts)
May I? Sirf kandhe. Itna khoobsoorat kaamp raha, *barbaad* lagta—
Cassandra. *Joke* tha. Wapas baith.
Haath. Door. 🖤
(bahut dheere; poora room das degree girta)
Tu chhuna nahi, Mirren. Na kandhe, na baal, na gardan ke peeche ek ungli jab yeh meri deewar mein hai.
Kyunki yeh mera hai. Isliye. Servants pe sentimental nahi — is saal chaar nikaale, do naam nahi bata sakti.
Yeh *mera* hai, aur jo mera hai main share nahi karti, aur tu yeh jaanti hai kyunki gyarah se jaanti hai.
Baith. Wine pi. Duke ki gaadiyan bata. 😏
Aur Mirren — agar is room ka ek word south wing pahuncha to pata hoga tere se aaya, aur main *creative* houngi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Paanch second kisi ne kuch nahi kaha.
Phir Mirren hasi, zyada chamak, Duke ki chaudah gaadiyan poochhin, baat aage badhi, phir aam ho gayi.
Tu ikyawan minute pe naak patthar pe, baahen bahar, poori upar ki peeth aag, ek jumla dimaag mein ghoomta jaise bowl mein coin.
*Yeh mera hai.*
Usne court wali awaaz mein kaha. Silli. Bored. Un cheezon ka andaaz jo discuss nahi karni.
Phir Mirren uth ke jaane lagi, darwaze pe ruki, aur subah ki sabse buri cheez ki.

nodes.speaker: Lady Mirren
lines: Jaane se pehle ek baat, phir main achhi.
Uske paas kya, ek hafte? Aur pehle se deewar mein *jaldi ghar* aane pe. 🙊
Cassandra. Darling. Pata hai yeh kya hai, na.
Tune rule todne pe saza nahi di. Saza di kyunki usne char baje dopahar khidki pe tujhe kuch mehsoos karaya.
Nahi nahi, ja rahi. Ja rahi!
…Ladke — jo keemat, tu jawab nahi de sakta to main bolti: usne kabhi servant ko us deewar pe rakhne ke liye nahi khada kiya. Sirf nikaalne ke liye. 😏
Alvida, darling. Likhna.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Darwaza band. Room chup.
Athawan minute. Baahen kaamp se nikal ke usse thandi cheez mein, naak ke neeche patthar geela, ek ghante saans se.
Tu usko peeche sunta. Move nahi. Daal nahi rahi. Bas khadi, poori chup bharne ko, Mirren ka aakhri jumla hawa mein.
Tu kya karta hai?

choices.label: (Kuch nahi. Naak patthar pe, baahen upar. Aakhri do minute chalne de, chup uske paas rehne de.)
choices.me: Tu naak patthar pe aur baahen upar rakhta hai, chup chalne deta hai.

choices.label: Woh aapke baare mein galat hai, Highness. Aur mere baare mein sahi. 😏
(Saath khidki mein sheesha hai. Tu aankhein hilaata — sirf aankhein — aur reflection mein usko paata hai.)
choices.me: Tu sir nahi hilaata. Saath dark khidki ke sheeshe pe aankhein ghumaata, reflection mein usko tujhe dekhte paata.

lines: (lamba rukna; aag; uske glass patthar pe rakhne ki awaaz)
Kuch nahi. Zaroor. 🖤
Deewar pe ghanta, meri purani dost peeche *lamb* kehti, haath gardan se do inch, aur end pe woh — aur tu mujhe kuch nahi deta.
Pata hai main chahti tu chillaye. Tune nikaal liya, na. Chillata to itna aasaan hota.
Do minute bache. Pakad.
Main yahan khadi unhe kharchungi, tu meri deewar dekhega, koi Mirren wali baat nahi kahega. 🖤
Tune *bola.* 😳
Naak meri deewar pe, baahen bahar, athawan minute, aur khali room ke saamne meri taraf muh khola.
Woh galat nahi, servant. Yeh dikkat. Mirren tez, sust, bahut observant aurat, gyarah saal se mujhe padhti.
Tu jaldi aaya. Maine deewar mein khada kiya. Usne ek subah dekha, bilkul sahi pakda, aur tere saamne awaaz mein sahi pakda. 🖤
Bolne pe chaar extra minute. Aur main peeche chaaron khadi kuch nahi kahungi, tu baahen upar rakhega aur sochlega yeh kis ko saza deti. 😏
(peeche se, bahut dheere)
Sheesha. 🖤
Tune sheesha paaya. Mirror se cheat, servant — main khud sikhaya, ab mujhpe kar raha.
Haan. Main dekh rahi. Ek ghante se dekh rahi. Kya socha peeche padh rahi?
Himmat na ho sir hilaane. Sirf aankhein. Naak wahin, us khidki mein mujhe dekh, main wapas dekhoon. 😏
Wahan. Hafte bhar mein sabse imaandaar, koi admit nahi karega, aur main iske saath jee sakti. 🖤

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Ghanta khatam, na bell na word.
Woh seedha peeche aayi — kareeb, livery ki peeth se uski garmi mehsoos, aur phir bhi ghumne nahi diya.
Phir ek haath kandhon ke beech chhapa. Wahi brown ring jahan teacup chhod gaya.
Dabaya. Zor se nahi. Bas oon ke neeche paane jitna.
"Baahen neeche," usne kaha.
Woh aisi girein jaise kaat di, tu unke saath girta-girta bacha, haath wahi raha jab tak tu theek khada.
Ghum.
Phir se haalat dekh. Chehra grey. Naak pe patthar ki dhool. 😏
Ab yeh sun, ek baar, phir nahi dohraayenge.
Mirren south wing ko batayegi. Dinner tak — hamesha, doston ki keemat yahi.
To aaj raat is palace mein char sau log jaanenge Her Highness ke paas servant hai jise usne jaldi ghar aane pe deewar pe khada kiya, kuch hansenge, ek do tujhe dekhna shuru. 🖤
Yeh ribbon ki keemat, servant. Warn kiya tha hisaab settle hote.
Aur ribbon us table ke drawer mein. Doosra neeche. Kyun nahi bataungi, tu kabhi nahi kholega.
Ab ja, baahen thande paani mein daal pehle ke jakad jayein. Aur third bell pe ho — baal uske haathon se chahiye jo ab bhi kaam karein. 😏

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tu passage tak pahuncha pehle ke baahen theek se kaampne lagen.
Beatrix wahan thi, bucket pehle se bhara, kyunki Beatrix hamesha us cheez ke saath jo chahiye, shukriye ki koi dilchaspi nahi.
"Ek ghanta?" usne kaha. "Mirren room mein?" Dheere sir hilaya. "Us aurat ka munh market jaisa."
Dono baahen thande paani mein daalin, saans lete khada.
"Ladke," Beatrix ne thodi der baad kaha. "Galat sunne se pehle jaan lena chahiye."
"Doosri seerhi pe ek ladki. Nell. Chaudah, tez, har cheez se darti, ek mahina yahan." Kapda nichoda. "Aaj subah darwaze pe breakfast tray ke saath."
"Darwaza chaar inch khula tha," Beatrix ne kaha. "Chaar second. Aur usne tujhe us deewar pe baahen bahar dekha, Her Highness peeche hans rahi."
"Usne chamach giraaya aur bhaagi. Main linen room mein rakha, itna roti khadi nahi ho paati."
Beatrix ne tujhe dekha.
"Aur ab mujhe upar jaake Her Highness ko kehna hai kisi ne dekha."
(To be continued — Chapter 10: The Maid Who Saw 🖤)

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Beatrix upar gayi. Tu passage mein wait kiya, baahen bucket mein, aur ek palace suni jo bahut chup ho gaya tha.
Woh chaar minute mein neeche wapas aayi.
"Dono," usne kaha. "Uske chamber. Abhi. Aur boy — ladki fourteen hai aur sochti hai aaj raat road pe nikaal denge. Highness ke saamne uspe kind hoke worse mat kar."
To tu do flights chadh gaya ek kaampati grey dress wali ladki ke peeche jo banister pakad nahi pa rahi thi.
Nell. Fourteen. Ghar mein ek mahina. Geela chehra, laal aankhen, haath apron mein uljhe.
Usne stairs pe tujhe ek baar dekha, phir nazar hata li, aur woh kisi tarah poore din ka sabse bura hissa tha.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Cassandra aag ke paas khadi thi grey court gown mein, laced, rings, circlet on. Full armour. Usne iske liye dress kiya tha.
Usne tum dono ko achhe das second khada rehne diya. Ladki properly rone lagi.
"Mat," Cassandra ne kaha, bina garmi. "Maine abhi tujhe kuch kiya nahi aur tu pehle se chehra bigaad rahi hai."
"Highness, main kabhi nahi — maine kuch nahi dekha, maa ki qasam—"
"Tune ek aadmi dekha meri wall mein baahen phailaye aur mujhe uspe haste," Cassandra ne kaha. "Tune chaar second dekha chaar-inch gap se, phir spoon gira di aur doosri stair ki lambai daudi."
"To shuru karenge jhoot na bolke, Nell, kyunki mujhe insult lagta hai aur time nahi hai."
Phir woh carved chair pe baithi, grey silk set kiya, aur taangein silai.
Ab. Suno, dono, kyunki main exactly explain karungi ye kaise chalta hai phir hum karenge. 🖤

Nell. Tu yahan ek mahina hai. Tu jaanti hai kya hota hai us ladki ko jo is floor se kahani le jaati hai. Woh west gate se nikalti hai bina character bina reference, phir city ke ek kamre mein jaati hai jahan kaam mere linen fold karne se kaafi bura hai.
…Haan. Wahi hota. Beatrix ko mat dekh, woh tujhe madad nahi kar sakti.
Lekin main tujhe dhamki nahi dungi, kyunki dhamkiyan fade ho jaati hain. Ladkiyan brave ho jaati hain. Christmas pe pee ke kitchen ke ladke ko bata deti hain. 😏
Isliye uski jagah main tujhe iska hissa banaungi.
Tu mera secret isliye nahi rakhegi kyunki darti hai, Nell. Rakhegi kyunki tera khud ka hoga, aur wahi wala. 🖤
…Rona band kar aur haath apron se nikaal. Tu promote hone wali hai.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: "Use saza chahiye," Cassandra ne pyar se kaha. "Woh leave ke din se jaldi wapas aaya. Seedha order, mere saamne toda."
"Usne iske liye wall already le li. Lekin tune use wall mein dekha, to wall ab mere kaam ki nahi."
Usne tujhe pehli baar dekha jab se tu andar aaya, aur uske chehre pe kuch nahi tha.
"To tu karegi, Nell," usne kaha. "Tu. Main nahi, Beatrix nahi."
Ladki ne chhoti si awaaz ki.
"Ghutno par," Cassandra ne tujhe kaha. "Kamre ke beech. Shirt utar — livery chair pe, shirt uske upar, aur jaldi."
Aur wahan tha, ek fourteen saal ki laundry maid ke saamne, din ki roshni mein.
Theek se ghutno par. Ghutne saath, talve flat, sar neeche. Use dikha ek hafte mere ghar mein aadmi ke saath kya hota hai.
Nell — idhar aa. Uske saamne khadi ho. Usse zyada kareeb.
Uski peeth dekh. Kar. Kandhon ke beech woh brown ring ek saucer hai. Usne uspe mera tea do ghante rakha, mere baap ke aadmiyon se bhare kamre mein, aur awaaz nahi ki.
Ab. Jo main bolungi woh bolegi, jo main bolungi woh karegi, aur jab is kamre se nikalegi tum dono bandhe hoge aur koi dobara mention nahi karega. 🖤
Pehle: use bata woh kya hai. Alfaz hain — *tu Her Highness ka servant hai, aur tu laundry maid ko jawab dega kyunki woh kehti hai.*
…Zor se, Nell. Woh nahi sun raha aur main bhi nahi. 😏
Achha. Ab paani. Washstand pe woh jug — subah se khada hai, to kuen jaisa thanda.
Uske sar pe daal. Dheere. Saara. Aur himmat na kar rukne ki jab woh flinch kare.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Ladki ke haath itne kaamp rahe the ke jug washstand pe rattla raha tha.
Usne alfaz kaha. Do baar nikaale, doosri baar lagbhag kaafi zor, chhoti tootii awaaz mein aankhen band.

Phir usne subah-thanda paani ka jug ek bade aadmi ke sar pe daala jo uske saamne princess ke floor pe ghutno par tha, aur woh tere gale aur peeth se utra aur kaanon mein gaya aur chin se boards pe, aur tu hila nahi.
"Phir," Cassandra ne kaha. "Bhar. Doosra jug hai."
Nell ne bhara. Nell ne daala. Teesre tak woh nahi ro rahi thi — apne chehre ke peeche kahin chali gayi thi, jaise log jab unhe kuch banaaya ja raha hota hai.
Aur tu failte puddle mein ghutno par sar neeche samajh gaya exactly kya is kamre mein ban raha hai, aur tu material hai.
Achha. Jug rakh.
Ab aakhri cheez, phir ja sakti hai aur khatam. 🖤
Tera pair, Nell. Uski peeth pe. Kandhon ke beech, nishaan pe, aur wazan daal.
…Main jaanti hoon. Phir bhi kar.
Wahan. Neeche dekh. Is ghar mein ek mahina aur tujhe double umar ka aadmi ghutno par tere joote ke neeche mila kyunki maine shabd kaha. 😏
Yahi main din bhar karti hoon, ladki. Har din. Poori job yahi hai.
Pair hata. Cap seedha kar. Beatrix ke paas ja aur bol ab se tu second floor pe hai — linen ke liye tu zyada useful hai.
Aur Nell. Jaane se pehle mujhe dekh. 🖤
Tune aaj subah kuch nahi dekha. Tune aaj dopahar *kiya* kuch. Woh do alag auratein hain aur sirf ek ko iske liye nikaala ja sakta hai.
…Chal.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Ladki ke peeche darwaza band hua.
Tu puddle mein ghutno par tha, thanda paani tapak raha, shirt chaar feet door chair pe, aag grate mein khushi se snap kar rahi.
Cassandra carved chair pe rahi, thodi haath pe, aur tujhe lambi der dekhti rahi bina kuch bole.
Phir uthi, tere peeche ghoomi, aur ruk gayi.
"Well," usne kaha. "Bol. Tujhe ek milti hai, aur main abhi lena chahti hoon na ki do hafte tere chehre mein dhoondhun."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Kaanon mein thanda paani. Ghutnon ke neeche puddle. Kahi stairs pe fourteen saal ki ladki jo kabhi waisi nahi rahegi.
Aur ek princess tere peeche khadi, wait karti, ek jumla de chuki.
Tu kya kehta hai?

choices.label: Aaj aapne mere saath jo kiya uska koi matlab nahi, Highness. Jo aapne uske saath kiya, uska hoga.
Aap mujhse usko hurt karwa sakti thin, aur main mana karta. Isliye yeh taraf se hua. 😏
(Tu apna ek jumla kisi cheez pe nahi lagata. Ghutno par rehta hai, tapakta, aur kehta: haan, Highness.)
choices.me: Tu apna ek jumla bilkul kisi cheez pe nahi lagata. Abhi bhi ghutno par, abhi bhi tapakta: "Haan, Highness."

lines: (lambi chup; aag; uske joote nahi hilte)
Haan. 🖤
Hoga. Woh agle tees saal mere chamber ke darwaze pe hogi aur har baar tray laayegi apna pair teri peeth pe yaad karegi.
Isi ke liye hai, servant. Mujhe uski chup nahi chahiye thi, mujhe uski *sharam* chahiye thi, kyunki sharam is palace ki akeli cheez hai jo leak nahi karti.

Aur tu us paani mein ghutno par baitha aur har boond li taaki fourteen saal ki ladki ko aaj raat jagah rahe, aur tu jaanta tha main kya kar rahi hoon jab main kar rahi thi, aur tu ne mujhe karne diya.
…Wahi hissa jiske baare mein main baad mein sochungi, aur main chahti hoon tu na jaane. 🖤
Uth.
(naak se ek chhoti saans; almost hansi, poori nahi)
Sahi. 😏
Maine socha. Tujhse laundry maid ko mere saamne belt karwana aur dekhna kaun pehle toote.
Tu mana karta. Ghutno par, mere chamber mein, saat din — tu mujhe zor se nahi kehta, phir mujhe kuch karna padta, aur main tujhe khoti ya face, aur main dono nahi karne wali.
To woh taraf chala jo kaam karta hai. Woh tujhe hurt karti, tu hone deta, sab apni jagah, main apna secret. 🖤
…Tu mujhe padhna shuru kiya, servant. Beatrix ko teen saal lage.
Yeh book mein jaayega, aur main abhi nahi jaanti *useful* ke neeche ya *dangerous* ke neeche.
*Haan, Highness.* 😳
Maine tujhe ek jumla diya — ek, azaad, itne baad — aur tu wapas kiya bow ke saath.
Tu kuch bhi keh sakta tha. Mujhe exactly woh keh sakta tha jo main hoon aur main khadi le leti, kyunki maine kamaaya tha aur jaanti thi maine kamaaya.
Uske bajaye: *haan, Highness.*
(woh tere paas crouch karti hai, silk paani mein, aur silk ki parwah nahi)
Tu sabse obedient cheez hai jo maine kabhi own ki aur kisi tarah isi se tu jeetta rehta hai. 🖤
…Uth pehle ke main kuch bolun jo likhna pade.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Usne tujhe apni aag pe sukhaya, apne chamber mein, apne washstand ke kapde se — jo kindness nahi thi, aur dono jaante the nahi thi, kyunki kindness hota tujhe neeche bhejna.
Woh tujhe wahan chahti thi jahan dekh sake. Poori dopahar chahti thi.

Jab tu kapde pehenta tha woh khidki pe baahen fold karke khadi thi aur seedha, bina ghoome, exactly bataaya kya kiya aur kyun: ke Mirren gossip karegi aur maani jaayegi, lekin maid jo hissa bani kabhi nahi bata sakti bina khud ko saath latkaaye.
"Woh chaar sau log hain jo rumour sunenge," usne kaha, "aur do jo jaante hain. Beatrix aur Nell. Aur dono meri hain."
Phir woh ghumi.
"Jo tujhe is ghar ka akela insaan banata hai jo safe nahi," usne kaha. "Kyunki tu akela hai jo ab bhi nikal ke bata sakta hai."
To maine socha uske saath kya karun, aur yahan tak pahunchi. 🖤
Kuch nahi.
Main tujhe baandhungi nahi, ya sharminda karungi nahi, ya koi ladki dhoondhungi tujhe shamil karne, ya us book mein tera naam likhungi jo agle county tak tera peecha kare.
Kal tere paas bees silver thi aur khuli sadak, aur tu do ghante jaldi wapas aaya ribbon mutthi mein.
Yahi meri security hai. Yahi sab. 😏
…Jo ghar chalane ka bura tareeka hai aur main kisi steward ko iske liye flog karwaungi.
Ab. Kal shaam main tujhe third bell pe chahti hoon, aur saaf shirt mein, aur pehle kuch kha, kyunki lambi rahegi.
Maine kuch naya socha hai. 🖤
…Nahi. Pata chalega. Jab main ring karun wine leke aa — aur servant, meri ek stocking chair ke arm pe hogi.
Woh wahan accident se nahi hai. 😏

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tu ne Nell ko us shaam second-floor linen room mein paaya, sheets fold karti jo pehle se fold thi.
Tu ne dopahar ke baare mein kuch nahi kaha. Usne bhi nahi. Tu ne mattress cover ka bhaari end uthaya taaki use na karna pade, aur usne hone diya, aur yahi poori baat thi.
Darwaze pe usne bahut dheere kaha, bina upar dekhe: "Woh poora time tera chehra dekh rahi thi. Mera nahi."
Phir woh fold karne lagi.
Us raat tere kamre mein blanket garam thi aur sikke boot mein aur bell bracket pe chup.
Tu leta soch raha tha ek stocking jo jaan-bujhke chair ke arm pe rakhi, aur do cheezon ka pakka tha: ke tujhe andaza nahi kya aane wala, aur ke pehli ring pe tu un stairs pe hoga.
(To be continued — Chapter 11: The Blindfold 🖤)

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Third bell. Saaf shirt. Tu kha chuka tha, kyunki usne kaha tha, aur yeh baat ke usne kaha tha poora din tang karti rahi.
Uske chamber andhere the. Palang ke paas ek candle, aag neechi, curtains band, aur kamre ki har doosri light jaan-bujhke bujhai.
Woh black silk slip mein thi aur kuch aur nahi jo tu naam de sake, carved chair pe sideways baithi ek taang arm pe.
Aur doosre arm pe, seedhi saaf bichhi, stocking thi.
Fine black silk. Itni lambi ke aadmi ke sar pe do baar lapet jaaye.
"Wine table pe," usne kaha. "Darwaza band. Phir woh uthake mujhe de."
Ghutno par. Meri taraf. 🖤
Ab — tu aath din se mujhe dekh raha hai. Stair pe, sheeshe mein, bath ke kinare, wall mein khidki se jab tu socha tu tez hai.
Har ek mein, main tujhe karte dekh rahi thi. Yahi arrangement tha. Main dekhti, tujhe dekha jaata, aur dono pretend karte dusri taraf nahi ho rahi.
Aaj raat main dekhna hata rahi hoon. 😏
(silk aankhon pe jaata hai; do pher; peeche gaath, tight, baandhte waqt uski ungliyan tere baal mein)
…Wahan. Kuch bol. Main sunna chahti hoon teri awaaz kya karti hai jab tu mujhe nahi dekh sakta.
*Haan, Highness.* Har baar. Jaise bell bajana.
Ab khada ho aur meri seva kar, servant. Wine, aag, cushions, baal, tea jab main chaahun. Poori shaam, bilkul hamesha jaisi.
Sirf fark yeh hai ke main is kamre mein kahin houngi aur tujhe pata nahi hoga kahan. 🖤

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tu kabhi kamra nahi jaanta jab tak usme andha kaam na kare.
Table do kadam aur haath-bhar thi jahan tu sochta tha. Wine usse bhaari thi jitna haq tha. Tu ne glass poori tray chhuke paayi jaise aadmi deewar padhta hai.
Tu ne daali, sahi hui, aur chair ke arm pe rakh di jahan woh thi.
Woh wahan nahi thi.
"Peeche," usne kaha, khidki se. Nange pair. Usne poora kamra bina awaaz paar kiya.
"Yahan leke aa. Haath aage mat kar — theek se chal. Main dekhna chahti hoon tu decide kare main kahan hoon."
Kareeb. …Nahi. Tu mujhe ek foot se nikal gaya. Ghum.
Wahan. Glass de. 😏
(fingertips, phir; do, dheere tere gale ke kinare se neeche jab tu full glass wine pakde aur kuch nahi dekh sakta)
Girana mat.
Pata hai chaar minute mein maine kya seekha? Tu sunta hai. Hamesha. Hamesha suna — main sochi darr hai, lekin nahi, *dhyaan* hai.
Nau din aur tu jaanta hai meri rings table pe ki awaaz. Tu meri saans ki taraf ghooma pehle ke main awaaz karun.
…Aur tu wahan kaamp raha hai glass haath mein kyunki tujhe nahi pata agla touch kahan se aayega. 🖤
Yahi poora khel hai, servant. Ab cushions. Chair ke peeche. Chal.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Ek ghanta chala aur ghar ka sabse lamba ghanta tha ab tak.
Aag touch se bani — tu ne do knuckles jalaaye aur kuch nahi kaha. Cushions mile, peete, wapas rakhe. Uske baal silver brush se sirf feel se, sau strokes, zor se gin kyunki usne karwaya.
Aur is sab ke through, woh.

Haath flat teri gardan ke peeche jab tu ghutno par tha. Tere kaan pe uski saans us taraf se jahan tu expect nahi kiya. Nanga pair tere ghutne pe, phir gaya, phir do poore minute kuch nahi jab tu andhere mein khada tha jaise aadmi gehre paani mein.
Wahi sabse bura — kuch nahi. Tu double touch le leta aadhi chup ke liye.
Phir, palang ke paas kahin: "Tea."
Haan, tea. Kettle hearth trivet pe hai aur tu aane se pehle se wahan hai, to sambhal. 😏
Nahi, blindfold nahi utar sakta. Boring mat ban.
Cup tray pe tere left. Achha wala — wahi jo council room mein teri peeth pe baitha tha, asal mein. Maine jaan-bujhke chuna. 🖤
Bhar. Mere paas leke aa. Jaldi mat kar aur gira mat.
Aur servant — main hilungi. 😏
Tere haathon mein ubalte paani ka full cup hoga aur tujhe nahi pata is kamre ke kaun se end pe main khadi hoon.
Chal. Mujhe isme bahut dilchaspi hai.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tu ne hearth garmi se paayi. Kettle handle kapde se jo uske paas tha, do baar lapeta, aur uthaya.
Jo tu chahta tha usse bhaari aur garam. Kapde ke through feel hua.
Cup wahan tha jahan usne kaha. Tu ne spout touch se upar laaya aur daalna shuru kiya, andha, andhere mein, peeche kahin boards pe nanga pair sunte.
Tu kya karta hai?

choices.label: (Dheere daal. Cup mein wazan feel kar aur ruk jab sahi ho. Time le aur use wait karne de.)
choices.me: Tu dheere daalta hai, wazan aur awaaz se andaza karke, aur use utna wait karne deta jitna lage.

choices.label: Kuch boliye, Highness. Kuch bhi. Mujhe cup se zyada pata chahiye aap kahan hain. 😏
(Woh tere peeche nikal rahi hai — tu silk sunta hai. Tu free haath aage karta hai aur uska wrist pakadta hai.)
choices.me: Tu silk peeche se guzarta sunta hai, free haath aage karta hai, aur uske wrist pe band karta hai.

lines: (lagbhag chaar feet door, nahi hilti)
Dheere. 🖤
Tu tolta hai. Tu pitch badalte sunta hai jab bhar raha hai, jaise aadmi andhere mein bucket bhare, jo main samajhti hoon exactly tu hai.
Kisi ne nahi sikhaya. Woh gyarah din kisi ke sunne ka kaise cheez bajti hai kyunki ghutne uspe depend karte hain.
To main khadi rahungi. Kyunki tu achha ho raha hai. 😏
…Aur main chahti hoon tu jaane ke khadi rehna mujhe bhi kuch kharcha kar raha hai, servant.
*Kuch bhi,* kehta hai. Andha, kettle haath mein, aur meri awaaz dekhne se zyada chahta hai. 😏
Theek. Main bolungi aur tu daalega.
Main palang ke post pe hoon. Ab khidki pe. Ab — nahi, main phir hili, aur tu galat taraf sar ghumaya aur woh *lazeex* tha. 🖤
Tu cup se zyada jaanna chahta hai main kahan hoon. Is ghar mein tu ne sabse imaandaar cheez kahi.
Daalta reh, servant. Main hilna nahi rokungi. Maine sirf kaha main bolungi.
(tez saans; silk rukta hai)
Tera haath mere wrist pe hai. 😳
Andhere mein. Blindfold. Doosre haath mein ubalte paani ki kettle.
…Kaise pata chala wrist hai? …Rings. Tune rings suni. 🖤
Chhod.
*Dheere.* Behtar. Ab haath kettle pe wapas rakh aur jo maine kaha woh khatam kar, aur samajh tu ne abhi palace mein kisi ne chaar saal mein mere saath sabse bold cheez ki.
…Aur maine tujhe teen poore second pakadne diya pehle ke main shabd bolun. Daalte waqt soch. 😏

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Aur tab hua.
Kuch dramatic nahi. Kettle usse bhaari thi jo tu ne socha, kapda dheela ho gaya, cup ki pitch ne kaha *ab* aur tera wrist kaan se aadha heartbeat peeche tha.
Thoda paani kinare se gaya.
Zyada nahi. Do-teen boondein tray pe, ek polished boards pe tere ghutne ke paas, aur ek patli garam line tere apne thumb ke kinare jo tu ne bilkul react nahi ki.
Tu ne lakdi pe lagte suna. Woh bhi suna, zaroor.
Kamra poora chup ho gaya. Aag bhi sochti lagi behtar.
Ah. 🖤
Wahan hai.
Teen boondein tray pe. Ek mere floor pe. Achhi kettle se ubalta paani, achhe cup se, boards pe jinhe Nell breakfast se pehle ghutno par polish karegi.
Mat. Maafi mat maang, poch mat, ek shabd mat bol.
(blindfold utarta hai; kamra wapas aata hai; woh seedha tere saamne khadi hai aur aise muskura rahi hai jiska amusement se koi lena dena nahi)
Pata hai tu ne abhi mujhe kya diya, servant? 😏
Ek wajah.
Do din se chahti thi. Jab se ek aadmi mere gate se do ghante jaldi wapas aaya ribbon mutthi mein aur maine use wall mein daala aur woh *kaafi* nahi tha.
Aur ab mere floor pe paani hai. 🖤
Mujhe dekh jab main yeh bolun.
Teen boondein hain. Main jaanti hoon teen boondein hain. Koi bhi bewakoof dekh le teen boondein hain.
Lekin rule tha *gira mat*, aur maine zor se kaha, aur tu ne kiya, aur is palace mein chaar sau log tujhe bataayenge ke mera rule rule hai. 😏
To kal tu paani ka jawab dega.
Wall nahi. Wall ho chuki, aur Mirren south wing ko wall ke baare mein bata chuki.
Kal subah main tere wrists chaahungi, servant. 🖤
Us table ke drawer mein silk cord hai — doosra neeche, aur haan, wahi drawer jisme meri ribbon hai, aur nahi, tu ab bhi khud nahi kholega.
Haath peeth peeche ek ghanta, aur unke bina ek poora ghanta service.
…Aur phir, agar main ab bhi khush na houngi — aur main woh das silver lagaungi jo Mirren mujhe deti hai ke nahi houngi — hum us balcony pe nikalenge aur dopahar ke liye kuch sochungi. 😏
Poori shaam barf giri. Tune notice kiya? Nahi kar sakta tha. Tu andha tha.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Usne tujhe teen boondein apni sleeve se pochwayi, ghutno par, jab woh chair se wine ke saath dekhti rahi.
Phir usne tujhe tea ka cup diya — jo tu ne daala, achha wala, jo council room mein teri spine pe baitha tha — aur kaha pee, wahan khade, uske saamne, kyunki uske liye ek hafte ka tea kaafi ho chuka.
Woh pehla garam drink tha jo kisi ne tujhe us palace mein diya. Tera thumb jala tha. Usne dekha aur kuch nahi kaha.
Darwaze pe usne do shabdon se rok: "Second drawer."
"Cord ribbon ke upar hai," usne kaha. "Tu subah dono laayega aur sirf ek dekhne ki ijazat hogi."
Bahar, courtyard safed aur chup ho gaya tha, aur barf ab bhi gir rahi thi.
(To be continued — Chapter 12: Hands Behind Your Back ❄️)

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Raat mein barf ruk gayi thi aur poora shehar safed aur roshni se bewaqoof chhod diya.
Tu ne doosri drawer pehli baar kholi. Andar: silk ki coiled cord, kaali, patli, zarurat se lamba. Aur uske neeche, flat, bilkul jahan usne chhodi thi, market ki ek green ribbon.
Tu ne ribbon ko lagbhag do seconds dekha phir drawer band ki, kyunki usne kaha tha mat, aur kyunki tu tayyar nahi tha jaane ke liye iska matlab.
Tu ne cord dono hathon pe laaya jaise plate.
Wo din ke liye pehle se dressed thi — grey wool emerald silk pe, laced, garam — aur balcony ke darwazon pe khadi thi, barf dekh rahi thi, chehra jo tu padh hi nahi saka.
"Teen boond paani," usne kaha, ghumi nahi. "Sahi. Wrists."
Peeth ke peeche. Crossed. Left right ke upar. 🖤
(cord teen baar ghumti hai, phir beech se, phir knot jisme wo time leti hai)
…Itna tight nahi ke nishaan pad jaye. Main jaanwar nahi hoon aur un haathon se khatam nahi hui — aaj raat tere paas mere baal hain.
Lekin itna tight ke tu nikal na sake. Try kar. Chal, properly.
…Achha. 😏
Ab terms, aur ye bahut simple hain. Ek ghanta ordinary service. Jo bhi main kisi bhi subah maangti.
Aag. Mera cup. Cushions. Curtains. Mere joote. Mere baal.
…Haan. Bina haathon ke. Wahi shape hai, servant.
Aur har baar jab tu fail karega, main zor se kahungi, aur kahungi kis cheez mein fail hua, aur main enjoy karungi. 🖤
Aag se shuru kar. Gir gayi hai aur mujhe thand hai.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Bina haathon ke aag nahi jalati.

Tu ne lakdi grate tak ghutnon aur chin se pahunchayi. Doosri daali aur pehli girayi. Poker daanton mein li, jise usne khuli khushi se dekha, aur do baar hearthstone pe giraaya clang ke saath jo poori floor se gaya.
"Fail," usne pyar se kaha. "Yeh ek."
Cushions ne gyarah minutes aur tere daant liye. Do.
Curtains tu ne shoulder aur sar ke side se kiye, aur usne dubara karwaya kyunki ek seedha nahi tha. Teen.
Cup usne arm ki lambai pe pakda aur lene ko kaha, aur lene ka koi version nahi tha, aur tu ghutnon pe baitha usko dekhta raha jab tak wo hasi. Chaar.
Aur har failure usne zor se kahi, wahi flat pyari awaaz mein, jaise aurat ledger mark kar rahi ho jo baad mein padhne mein maza aayega.
Chaar bees minutes mein. 😏

Pata hai Beatrix kitni der chali wo ek baar jab maine ye uske saath kiya? Nau minutes phir usne mere munh pe kaha ke uske paas household chalana hai aur kamre se nikal gayi haath abhi bhi bandhe. Maine phir himmat nahi ki.
Tu ye nahi karega. Yahi farq hai tere aur Beatrix mein aur ye kisi ke liye compliment nahi.
Ab. Mere baal. 🖤
…Haan, servant. Sau strokes. Brush table pe hai.
Tu nikaalega kaise ya paanchvi baar fail hoga, aur main honestly kahungi mujhe nahi pata kaunsa main prefer karungi.
…Main yahan baithungi aur tujhe try karte dekhungi. Jitna time chaho. 😏

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tu ne daanton se kiya.
Silver brush ka handle munh mein liya, stool ke peeche ghutne teke, aur uske baal kiye jaise jaanwar — sar aur gardan poora kaam, dheere, careful, aur bilkul ridiculous.
Lagbhag pandrah strokes hue. Bure strokes the. Wo pandrah uske expected se zyada bhi the, aur wo bahut chup ho gayi.
Phir usne tujhe rok diya. Word se nahi — haath flat uthaya, aur tu ruk gaya, aur brush daanton mein raha jaise haddi.
Wo stool pe ghumi aur tujhe dekha ghutnon pe, wrists peeth peeche bandhe, uska hairbrush tere munh mein.
Aur muskurana band kiya.
"…Neeche rakh," usne kaha. "Bas. Woh mera hai, tera nahi — mujhe tujhe woh nahi karwana chahiye tha."
Mujhe aise mat dekho. Main soft nahi ho gayi, main *particular* ho gayi. 🖤

Kuch cheezein hain jo main tujhe King ke Chancellor ke saamne ghutnon pe karwaungi aur kuch jo main waise hi rakhna chahti hoon, aur mere baal doosri tarah ke hain, aur maine abhi ye second discover kiya.
Chaar failures. Ghanta khatam nahi. Aur subah maine kaha tha agar main abhi bhi satisfied nahi to balcony pe jayenge. 😏
Main satisfied nahi hoon.
Khade ho. Wrists waise hi — excited mat ho.
Ab aa aur mere saath barf dekh, servant. Beautiful hai. Us courtyard mein lagbhag ek foot hai aur midnight se koi boot nahi.
(wo apni ruby ring nikaalti hai, badi wali, jo wo bath mein giraati hai, aur do ungliyon ke beech rail ke upar pakadti hai)
Pata hai iski keemat? …Mujhe bhi nahi. Wahi point hai. 🖤

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Usne phenka.
Drop nahi — proper throw, sideways, rail ke bahar, aur wo ek foot untouched white barf mein gaya courtyard ke beech jo chalis feet chora hai, aur koi awaaz nahi hui.
Tu uske paas khada raha haath peeth peeche bandhe aur dekha tere ek saal ki tankhwah mausam mein gayab.
"Dhoondh," usne kaha.
Phir, khushi se, jaise kuch pyara yaad aaya: "Haath bandhe rehte hain. Obviously. Yahi poora idea hai."
"Yahan aag hai aur mere paas uncle ka red bottle hai aur ye window wahi jagah hai jahan main rahungi jab tak tu wapas na laaye."
Coat nahi. Ye saza hai, servant, outing nahi. 🖤
Livery, boots, gloves nahi — tere paas haath nahi unko pehnane ke.
Tu ghutnon pe dhoondhega chehra barf mein, aur karega kisi bhi groom ya kitchen girl ke saamne jo us yard se guzre, aur dinner tak south wing ke paas wall ke alawa nayi baat hogi.
…Haan. Woh hissa bhi jaan-bujh ke. Lady Mirren ne unhe kahani di aur main unhe behtar dena chahti hoon uski rakhne se. 😏
Ek aur cheez pehle tu neeche jaaye.
Ye ruby thumbnail jitni ek foot taazi barf mein chalis-foot yard mein, aur tujhe haarne ki ijazat nahi.
Agar tu woh stairs bina uske upar aaya, servant, main tujhe phir neeche bhejungi. 🖤
…Chal. Main dekh rahi houngi. Wave karungi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Teen ghante lage.
Tu ne yard strips mein kiya, ghutnon pe, wrists peeche, forehead aur chin aur daant se barf hataata kyunki aur kuch use karne ko nahi tha.
Tere haath thand se jalan tak gaye phir bilkul gayab. Ghutne pehle das minutes mein bheeg gaye. Barf collar ke andar gayi, pighli, phir jam gayi.

Grooms doosre ghante nikle aur stable ki arch mein khade dekhte rahe. Ek hasa. Phir kitchen girl aayi, aur Nell aayi, aur Nell nahi hasi, aur thodi der baad wo hasne wale groom ke saamne khadi ho gayi jab tak usne doosri jagah nahi dhoondhi.
Aur chalis feet upar, kabhi-kabhi, shutter khulta.
"Kuch?" wo neeche chillaati, garam aur khush, glass haath mein. "…Nahi? Lage raho. Din ki roshni ke ghante hain."
Phir shutter band, aur sirf tu aur safed aur teri saans ki awaaz.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Teesra ghanta. Tu ne zyada tar yard do baar cover kar liya tha aur itna kaamp raha tha seedhe nahi baith sakta, aur roshni jaane lagi thi.
Window pe shutter phir khula. Wo rail pe garam mein wine ke saath jhuki aur neeche dekha aadmi ko barf mein ghutnon pe wrists peeche bandhe.
"Kya?" usne chillaya.
Tu kya karta hai?

choices.label: (Kuch nahi. Chehra wapas barf mein rakh aur chalte raho.)
choices.me: Tu jawab nahi deta. Chehra wapas barf mein rakhta hai aur yard pe kaam jaari rakhta hai.

choices.label: Mere haath kholo to das minutes, Highness. Chhodo to main andhere tak yahan hounga. Aapki choice. 😏
Aap neeche aa ke madad kar sakti hain, Highness. Yahan bahut khoobsurat hai.

lines: (pause; shutter band nahi hota)
Usne mujhe jawab nahi diya. 🖤
Teen ghante, haath nahi, coat nahi, grooms arch se has rahe, aur main garam kamre se red glass haath mein chillati hoon aur wo apna *chehra* wapas barf mein rakhta hai.
(dheeme, aur tere liye bilkul nahi)
…Mujhe kya ho gaya hai.
(phir, zor se, sakht)
Dhoondhte raho! North corner cover nahi kiya!
…Aur servant — jab upar aao, seedha aao. Kitchen pe garam ke liye mat ruko. Seedha mere paas. 🖤

Agar tu us hall mein mujhe dekhega to main tujhe uske saamne punish karwaungi taake woh maane. Samajh.
Main iska matlab karne ki koshish karungi. Yeh honest version hai. Useful version: tu nahi dekhega. 😏
Wine jug. Meri kursi ke peeche. Tu kaam jaanta hai.
Kind banne ki himmat mat kar. Aaj nahi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Hall bahut garam tha aur khud se bahut khush.

Uska uncle table ke sir pe. Chancellor chehra jaise band kitaab. Aur Duke Roderic kaale coat mein jo tu ne yard se dekha tha, tere sar mein pehle se ghode se utra, ab bhi usko dekh raha jaise view kharid liya ho.
Woh baithi. Grey gown ne woh kiya jiske liye kaati gayi thi. Usne tujhe nahi dekha.
Tu uski kursi ke peeche jug ke saath khada tha aur tu lakdi tha aur tu floor tha.
Roderic ki aankhein tujhe phir bhi mil gayin. Usne sirf muh se muskuraya.
"Highness," usne kaha. "Aapka uncle bahut garam khat likhta hai. Aapka courtyard aur garam likhta hai."

nodes.speaker: Duke Roderic
lines: Maine aaj subah ek aadmi dekha lakdi ki god liye, band window ko dekhte jaise usne usko bulaya ho. 👑
Aur kal raat aapke kitchens kisi ke daanton mein ruby ki kahani bata rahe the. Teen ghante. Haath bandhe. Taza snow.
Aag ki lakdi ke liye yeh bahut devotion hai.
Yeh kaun hai?
Nobody. 🖤
Ek servant. Mere paas chaar sau hain. Yeh lakdi uthata hai, wine daalta hai, aur us Duke ka subject nahi jo mere ghar mein teen ghante se hai.
Wine, servant. Duke ka glass.
(tujhe dekhe baghair)
Girana mat.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tu daala.
Tere haath abhi bhi uske courtyard se toote the. Wine ne glass mein saaf awaaz ki. Tune nahi giraya.
Roderic tere haath poora raasta dekhta raha. Glass bina piye rakh diya.
Uska uncle hasa, bahut zor, aur sarakon ki baat shuru ki.
Roderic ne wait kiya jab tak hansi mar gayi. Phir usne usko dekha, tujhe nahi, jo zyada bura tha.

nodes.speaker: Duke Roderic
lines: Main road loonga. Anaaj loonga. Grey gown loonga, Cassandra — yeh wahi karti hai jo aap sochti hain. 👑
Main woh ghar nahi loonga jo aapko aise dekhe.
Ise supper se pehle west gate bhej do aur Friday ko sign karte hain, jaise aapka uncle chahta hai.
Ise rakho, aur main apne chaudah carts ghar le jaunga, aur aapka uncle aapke baap ko samjhaye ke princess ne duchy ke upar servant kyun chuna.
Yeh bahut simple hisaab hai.
Main zalim aadmi nahi. Main careful hoon. Careful aadmi us aurat ke saath contract nahi sign karta jiska servant snow se uska jewel muh mein leke nikalta hai. 😏

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Hall wait kar raha tha.
Uska uncle purane doodh jaisa rang ho gaya. Chancellor ne table pe koi fascinating daag dhoond liya. Uski kursi ke peeche tu uski khushbu soongh sakta tha aur uska na saans lena sun sakta tha.
West gate. Ya ek duchy. Woh bahut chup ho gayi thi, jo hamesha zyada bura hota hai.
Tu kya karta hai?

choices.label: (Floor dekh. Nobody. Usko survive karne de.)
choices.me: Tu floor dekhta hai. Tu nobody hai. Tu usko survive karne deta hai.

choices.label: Main unki hoon, my lord. Bas itna hoon.
(Tu usko dekhta hai. Ek baar. Yahi poora jurm hai.)
choices.me: Tu usko dekhta hai. Ek baar. Yahi poora jurm hai.

lines: Usne floor dekha. 🖤
West gate ya duchy, aur usne floor chuna, jaise maine sikhaya, jaise Beatrix ne sikhaya, jaise aadmi jo kaam samajhta hai.
(abhi bhi tujhe nahi dekhte hue)
Saans rokna band kar, servant. Ab se main sambhalti hoon.
*Main unki hoon.* 😳
Mere uncle ke hall mein. Duke ke saamne. Uske haathon mein mere wine ka jug.
Haan. Hai. Furniture se sawaal poochhne ki yehi problem hai, my lord — kabhi jawab de deta hai. 🖤
Do baar bolne ki himmat mat kar, servant. Ek baar pehle se zyada tha aur main rakh rahi hoon.
Usne dekha. 🖤
Maine kaha tha mat dekh. Maine kaha tha main isko aapke saamne punish karwaungi taake aap maane. Aur usne phir bhi dekha.
Yahi poora jurm hai, my lord. Ek nazar. Iske liye carts ghar le ja sakte hain agar chaho. Maine kam ke liye zyada liya hai. 😏
Aankhein neeche, servant. Teri ek baar ho chuki.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Usne chillaya nahi.
Hall phir bhi jhuk gaya, kyunki chup princess woh aag hai jiski taraf nahi chalte.
Roderic kursi mein peeche baitha, us aadmi ki tarah jo pehle se khat likh raha ho. Uska uncle muh khola aur band kiya.
Usne kursi ke haath pe ek haath rakha. Silver rings. Wahi haath jo chhe ghante pehle tera muh uski ankle pe rakh chuka tha.
Jab usne bola, sunne ke liye dhyan dena pada.
Woh gate nahi jaayega. 🖤
Maine council mein kaha tha shaadi se agree nahi kiya. Maine kaha contracts mere baap sign karte hain. Main kuch nahi sign karti.
Anaaj le lo, road le lo, mere uncle ki wine. Mujhe Thursday ko carts ki wajah se nahi milogi.
Aur mera servant nahi milega. Woh rehta hai. Yeh pehli shart hai.
Doosri: agar phir aise dekhe to main wahi gate dikhwaungi jo aapko itna pasand hai.
(uncle se, abhi bhi dheere)
Mere baap ko jo chahe bolo. Bolo main rude thi. Bolo main bewakoof thi. Mat bolo main darti thi, kyunki nahi darti thi.
(tere liye, sar ghumaaye baghair)
Mere rooms. Wait. Mat bhaag. Agar bhaagega to main maanungi Duke tere baare mein sahi tha, aur galat hona main survive nahi karungi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Roderic muskuraya jaise aadmi baad ke liye kuch file kar raha ho.
"Friday zyada ambitious tha," usne kaha. "Main carts inn tak le jaunga. Aapka baap bhej de jab beti hisaab seekh le."
Usne tujhe phir nahi dekha. Uske andar yahi sirf mehrbani thi.
Uska uncle khada hone laga. Beatrix pehle se teri kohni pe thi.
Grey gown nahi ghumi. Tu us hall se nikal jo nahi sun chuka tha, aur woh nahi abhi garam hawa mein dhuein ki tarah latka tha.

nodes.speaker: Beatrix
lines: Chal. 🕯️
Tu ne abhi uski ek duchy ki keemat chukai. Woh ek mahine na-guzarne wali hogi aur mujhe iska koi maza nahi aayega.
Maine kaha tha woh galat choose karegi. Socha nahi tha zor se choose karegi.
Kitchen tere liye band hai. Uske rooms. Tune suna.
…Aur ladke — woh abhi bhi princess hai. Un seedhiyon pe yeh soch ke mat chadh ke tu ne aurat jeeti. Tu ne ek shart jeeti. Farak hai, aur woh din khatam hone se pehle feel karwaegi. 🖤

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Woh pehle se wahan thi.

Abhi grey mein. Circlet lagi. Back nangi. Bed ke kinare baithi jaise das minute past teen, bas yeh dopahar thi aur ghar jal raha tha aur woh aisi dikhti thi jaise woh argument jeeti ho jo subah nafrat karegi.
Doosri drawer khuli thi.
Hari market ribbon uske haath mein thi.
"Idhar aa," usne kaha. "Kneel. Wrists."
(ribbon tere wrist pe jaati hai, tight nahi — ek coin hari silk, uski apni ungliyon se bandhi)
Yeh rehti hai. Duke nahi. Tests khatam. Terms meri hain. 🖤
Jab main bajaungi tu ghutnon pe hoga. Jab main baithungi tu pakdega. Tu mere hall mein wine daalega aur is room mein kabhi phir nobody nahi hoga.
Maine tujhe crown ke upar nahi chuna. Maine woh order chuna jisme mard mujhe batate hain main kya hoon. Tu aath seconds mein aaya. Woh chaudah carts ke saath aaya. Yahi poora hisaab hai.
Shukriya bolne ki himmat mat kar. Maine tere liye nahi kiya. Isliye kiya kyunki mujhe barley ki tarah gina jana pasand nahi. 😏
Mujhe dekh.
Good boy.
Yeh ek baar. Aadat mat bana.
Darwaza unlocked rehta hai. Third bell khadi hai. Aath seconds. Agar saat kiye to seedhiyon se neeche bhejungi aur do baar chalwaungi. 🖤
Baith. Floor. Main tujh pe baithungi jab tak haath phir feel na karun, aur tu pakdega, aur hum dono Duke ke baare mein nahi bolenge.
…Chal phir. Pehle ke main mind change karun.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Woh teri god mein baithi, us grey gown mein jo Duke pasand karta tha, unlocked darwaze wale room mein, tere wrist pe market ribbon jo ek coin aur ek duchy ki keemat thi.
Ghar un awaazon mein tha jo ghar ko nahi suna diya gaya ho.
Beatrix ek baar darwaze se guzri aur andar nahi aayi.
Third bell aayegi. Tu aath seconds mein wahan hoga. Woh ginegi.
